Face Search AI is a powerful deep search and facial recognition app designed to help you explore the internet through p
bluejetty:00040738:ios.description:
The Official Face Search AI – Advanced Facial Recognition and Deep Image Search
Discover Where Any Face Appears Online:
Face Search AI is a powerful deep search and facial recognition app designed to help you explore the internet through photos. Using advanced AI technology, this face find and reverse image search tool scans the web to discover where a photo may appear online. Simply upload a clear image in popular formats such as JPEG, JPG, or PNG, and let Face Search AI perform an intelligent image search across websites to uncover visually similar results. Whether you are trying to find info about someone, reconnect with old contacts, verify identities, or conduct a people search, our AI powered engine works as your digital investigation assistant.
Advanced Facial Recognition Technology:
Built with next generation facial recognition and deep image analysis, Face Search AI compares facial features and patterns to deliver accurate and fast results. The system performs a true reverse face search, going beyond basic image search to execute a broader deep search across publicly available sources. Optimized for sharp and well lit face photos, our technology scans, analyzes, and generates relevant links where similar images may appear. In some cases, users may even discover visually similar faces or subtle resemblance results, adding another layer of insight to the search experience.
Smart Deep Search Engine for Modern Image Discovery:
Face Search AI offers functionality comparable to well known face search and reverse image platforms such as and similar facial recognition tools, while providing its own streamlined experience and unique search advantages. Users searching for tools like facecheck or advanced people search solutions will find Face Search AI delivers fast, intelligent, and accessible results. From deep web image search to reverse face lookup and facial recognition analysis, the platform is built for speed, simplicity, and reliable performance.
Constantly Improving AI Intelligence:
The platform is continuously evolving. With every update, our AI models enhance facial recognition precision, expand image search coverage, and improve deep search intelligence. If exact matches are not immediately found, the system continues refining its algorithms to deliver better and more comprehensive results over time.
Start Your Face Search Today:
Ready to experience the next generation of face search, reverse image search, and deep facial recognition? Upload a photo today and discover where a face appears online in seconds.
Terms Of Service(EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://facesearchai.org/privacy.html

bluejetty:00070301:ios.description:
Educational games for kids kindergarten are the most popular way to study nowadays and our building games will help them in their preschool education. So welcome our new game for toddlers full of cars, puzzles and other racing and building activities! 
Learn how to build a house - supermarket, manage a vast park of trucks and cars, take part in many mini-games - well, just enjoy this world of childhood :) 
Classic features: 
● Introducing a new location supermarket! Construct it gradually with intelligent building trucks;
● Meet a collection of construction machinery like trucks, tractor simulator, excavator, bulldozer etc.
● Arrange puzzles - enliven the cars!
● Build a car here. All the transport is just like in real life - you can build with them or take part in a hill climb truck racing! 
● Here you can visit a car wash! Clean trucks with water, soap and bubbles and dry it off so your car shines like a diamond! 
● Refueling station is always at your service - fill the cars up before going to a building site;
● Car fixing service is obligatory after any activity, because caring of your cars is important;
Dear parents, we are happy to announce that with this game you can gain at least a half an hour for your own business! 
Let your kids dive into educational and funny game. 
The kids will learn important developing things like motility, memory and imagination, isn’t it fruitful activity? Choosing the appropriate language (there are plenty) you help your baby train speaking and listening skills in his/her own language and learn new words from the foreign ones.
! We cared about security for kids and implemented the parents’ corner inside with accidental entry protection - a math riddle:).
Check the game now!:) 
Contact us at feedback.gokids@gmail.com we will be happy to hear some feedback from you!
Car games are designed specifically for children aged 2 years and older, full of animations child choice app free and colorful graphics, fully voiced characters preschool 2 year old games free and tasks, the interface is simple and clear to the child.
Privacy Policy: https://gokidsmobile.com/policy3.php
Terms of use: http://gokidsmobile.com/terms/

Make Reiki a daily habit and improve your Reiki sessions. ReikiAll is an app for Reiki practitioners of all levels.

bluejetty:00088792:ios.description:
Intermittent Fasting Tracker: Your Ultimate Guide to a Healthier You!
Welcome to the Intermittent Fasting Tracker, the essential app to help you achieve your wellness goals with ease. Whether you're a seasoned intermittent faster or just starting your journey, our app is designed to support and guide you every step of the way. Embrace a healthier lifestyle and discover the benefits of intermittent fasting today!
Why Choose Intermittent Fasting Tracker?
- Intuitive and User-Friendly: Our app is designed with simplicity in mind, making it easy for anyone to start and stick to their fasting routine.
- Comprehensive Tracking: Monitor your fasting periods and eating windows with ease.
- Personalized Insights: Gain valuable insights into your progress and make informed decisions to optimize your health.
Key Features
- Fasting Timer: Start and stop your fast with a single tap. 
- Customizable Plans: Choose from various intermittent fasting plans such as 14:10, 16:8, 18:6, and more. Tailor your plan to suit your lifestyle.
- Progress Tracking: Visualize your journey with intuitive graphs that display your fasting history and achievements over time.
- Health Insights: Stay informed with expert articles and tips on intermittent fasting, nutrition, and overall well-being.
Benefits of Intermittent Fasting
- Natural Weight Loss: Burn fat effectively without dieting or intense exercise.
- Enhanced Energy Levels: Feel more active and vibrant throughout the day.
- Improved Mental Clarity: Boost your brain function and stay focused.
- Better Metabolic Health: Improve your body's metabolic markers, including blood pressure, glucose levels, and insulin sensitivity.
Is Intermittent Fasting Safe? Yes! Intermittent fasting is a natural and safe way to improve your health. By giving your body a break from constant digestion, you allow it to switch to fat-burning mode, enhancing your overall well-being. However, if you have any health concerns, please consult your doctor before starting any fasting regimen.
Join the Community. Become a part of a growing community of individuals who have transformed their lives with intermittent fasting. Share your progress, stay motivated, and achieve your health goals together.
Free Trial Offer. Enjoy a risk-free trial period with the freedom to cancel anytime.

bluejetty:00070840:ios.summary:
EMT Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) exam with a high score on your first attempt.
EMT Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into conc
bluejetty:00070840:ios.description:
EMT Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) exam with a high score on your first attempt.
EMT Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into concepts related to EMT exam preparation, but also helps you increase your confidence in passing the exam on the first attempt by practicing thousands of exam-like questions.
### Passing the exam on the first attempt ###
In EMT Exam Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the range of official EMT exam requirements. In total, there are four certification categories for you to choose from, from easy to hard, according to the increasing difficulty and requirements of the exam, including EMR, EMT, AEMT & Paramedic. each category contains all five officially required exam subjects, each of which can be subdivided into a dozen areas according to the exam requirements. You have the flexibility to choose which subjects you need to practice, depending on your situation.
Specifically, these subjects include:
• Scene Size-Up and Safety
• Primary Assessment
• Secondary Assessment
• Patient Treatment and Transport
• Operations
### Key features ###
- Over 2,000 question exercises, each including detailed answer explanations
- Specialized exercises by content area, with the flexibility to switch at any time
- View an analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the EMT exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that every time you practice on EMT B Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions, while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high not only on the EMT exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://emt.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://emt.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00014143:ios.description:
Easily catalog your book collection. Automatic book details, cover art and estimated values.
Just scan ISBNs (barcode or text) or search our CLZ Core database by author and title.
CLZ Books is a paid subscription app, costing US $1.99 per month or US $19.99 per year.
Use the free 7-day trial to try all of the app's features and online services!
== 2 easy ways to add books: ==
1. Search our CLZ Core by ISBN:
 You can either scan ISBN barcodes or scan the ISBN numbers using OCR
 Guaranteed 98% success rate on ISBN lookups!
2. Search our CLZ Core by author and title
Our CLZ Core online book database automatically provides cover images and full book details, like author, title, publisher, publication date, plot, genres, subjects, estimated pricing, etc..
== Edit all fields ==
Modify all automatically provided details from Core, like Authors, Titles, Publishers, Publications Dates, Plot descriptions, etc.. you can even upload your own cover art (front and back!). Add personal details like condition, location, purchase date / price / store, notes, etc.. 
Create your own Custom Fields so that you can catalog information for which the app does not have a built-in data field.
== Create multiple collections ==
Collections will appear as Excel-like tabs at the bottom of your screen. E.g. for different people, to separate your physical books from your ebooks, to keep track of books you sold or have for sale, etc... 
== Fully customizable ==
Browse your book catalog as a list with small thumbnails or as cards with big images.
Sort any way you want, e.g. by author, title, publication date, date added etc.. Group your books into folders by author, publisher, genre, subject, location, etc...
== CLZ Cloud storage ==
Sync your data to the CLZ Cloud, to:
* Always have an online backup of your book organizer database.
* Sync your book library between multiple devices
* View and share your book collection online
== Got a question or need help? ==
We are always ready to help or to answer your questions, 7 days a week.
Just use "Contact Support" or "CLZ Club forum" from the menu.
== About CLZ ==
CLZ has been developing collection database software since 1996. Located in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, the CLZ team now consists of 12 guys and one gal. We're always working to bring you regular updates for the apps and software, and to keep our Core online databases up-to-date with all weekly releases.
Our other CLZ apps:
* CLZ Movies, for cataloging your DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHDs
* CLZ Music, for creating a database of your CDs and vinyl records
* CLZ Comics, for your collection of US comic books.
* CLZ Games, for creating a database of your video game collection
== What our users say ==
"A fantastically nice book library app that I am incredibly happy with, you really get an overview of the things that need to be sorted out, for a good overview, easy to use and everything works seamlessly. Strongly recommend."
Emmanate (Norway)
"The best I have found. I have over 1200 books and have used a number of book cataloging apps over the years. CLZ Books does the job of keeping track of my library and gets syncing right. Most importantly (speaking as a software developer) they keep improving the app. It’s tough to make a business of niche software products. These folks have apparently figured out how to make a go of it and they keep improving. Kudos to them!"
LEK2 (USA)
== About auto-renewable subscriptions ==
* The payment will be charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the purchase.
* The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
* Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.

bluejetty:00035442:ios.description:
Bubble Pop Shooter is an exhilarating bubble shooter puzzle game that will keep you hooked for hours on end! With a simple yet immersive gameplay, the objective of the game is to clear all the bubbles on the screen by shooting bubbles of the same color.
As a classic bubble shooter game, Bubble Pop Shooter will test your hand-eye coordination, as well as your puzzle solving skills. You'll need to aim carefully and strategically shoot the bubbles in order to create the best possible matches. The more bubbles you can match in a single shot, the more points you'll earn.
In addition to the classic bubble shooter gameplay, Bubble Pop Shooter also features a variety of power-ups and boosters that can help you clear the bubbles faster and more efficiently. Whether you're using a bomb to clear a large group of bubbles, or a rainbow bubble to match bubbles of any color, these boosters are essential to advancing through the game's levels.
We hope you have a great time with it!

bluejetty:00089093:ios.name: MyCatch Fishing App
bluejetty:00089093:ios.summary: Welcome to MyCatch by Angler’s Atlas - a fishing app to record your catches, participate in fishing events or just track your stats. You can explore thousands of fishing destinations through the app, and keep track of every fish caught. For
bluejetty:00089093:ios.description:
Welcome to MyCatch by Angler’s Atlas - a fishing app to record your catches, participate in fishing events or just track your stats. You can explore thousands of fishing destinations through the app, and keep track of every fish caught. For the competitive anglers, our fishing events give you a chance to fish for prizes AND contribute to fisheries science.
MyCatch was first released in 2018 as a way for anglers to track their catches and at the same time help fisheries biologists by providing important catch data. Since the launch, MyCatch anglers have worked with dozens of university researchers across Canada and the United States, helping address important questions and gaps in fisheries science. To see some examples of these projects, please visit our website at www.anglersatlas.com/research.
From a conservation standpoint, MyCatch has developed efficient catch reporting tools so anglers can quickly record their catch and get the fish back into the water in less than a minute. This approach is referred to as Catch-Photo-Release and are hallmarks of the event series available on the app.
“Our promise to anglers is that Secret Spots Stay Secret,” says Sean Simmons, Founder and President of Angler’s Atlas and MyCatch. “Our research partners sign data sharing agreements that protect the privacy and location of our anglers, while providing fisheries biologists with the critical data they need to study our fisheries.”
For anglers, the app also provides useful statistics to keep track of catches, such as the number of fish caught, catch rate, species and specific details around each catch.
My Catch is produced by Angler’s Atlas, an online platform that has catalogued hundreds of thousands of waterbodies, and helps anglers explore lakes, rivers and oceans with detailed maps, tips and local fishing information.
Sign up, report a catch, participate in an event and become a citizen scientist today!

bluejetty:00041767:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Go blow for blow against warriors around the world. Rule the ring with your favorite fighters in this hard-hitting version of the classic arcade game.
Take control of iconic fighters and test your mettle in hand-to-hand combat against players from all over the world. "Street Fighter IV: Champion Edition" perfects the original arcade game's winning formula with a host of updates and refinements for mobile devices. Long-time Street Fighter fans will feel right at home, while adjustable difficulty settings and tutorials set newer players on the path to victory.
PICK YOUR FIGHTER
Choose between 32 different Street Fighter characters, including new warriors added to the game since launch: Dudley, Ibuki, Poison, Guy, Gouken, Evil Ryu, Elena, Juri and Rose.
FACE OFF OR FLY SOLO
Battle head-to-head against players all over the globe with an online multiplayer option. Or, if you'd rather enter the ring on your own, choose between Arcade and Survival single-player modes.
FIND YOUR FIGHTING STYLE
Memorize each fighter's move sequences to deploy unique attacks and combos, or use SP Assist to instantly unleash special moves. With four difficulty levels, both veterans and new players can dive into combat.
TAKE IT OUTSIDE
High-resolution graphics, wide-screen support and intuitive virtual pad controls create a great play experience on mobile devices. Connect a controller to take your game to the next level (note that it won't function in menus — only during fights).
- Created by Capcom.

bluejetty:00080786:ios.name: Pixel Squad: War of Legends
bluejetty:00080786:ios.summary:
Welcome to Pixel Squad, a vibrant pixelated world made of tiny squares full of magic. It's like a shining star in a huge space. Here, time goes up and down, powerful gods became weaker, but new races were born.
Take on the mantle of the le
bluejetty:00080786:ios.description:
Welcome to Pixel Squad, a vibrant pixelated world made of tiny squares full of magic. It's like a shining star in a huge space. Here, time goes up and down, powerful gods became weaker, but new races were born.
Take on the mantle of the legendary and supreme legends then dive in strategic battles. 
MAGIC AWAITS, WHEREVER YOU ROAM.
Only you can lead heroes to draw forth the sword from the stone and unveil the verities of this world.
DISCOVER A PIXEL WORLD
• Guide the Six Factions to their Destiny
• Immerse yourself in a spellbinding saga, where you chart your own course through the captivating landscapes of Pixel Squad. From the sun-drenched fields of Pixel World to the eerie allure of the Dark Forest, traverse diverse realms and forge bonds with heroes from the Six Factions.
• Assume the main role, guiding these heroes on their destined path to greatness.
MASTER TACTICAL
• Overcome Every Obstacle with Precision
• Navigate battlefields, strategically assembling your hero lineup and arranging their positions. Opt for bold offensives or balanced compositions as you experiment with diverse formations, ushering forth an enthralling gameplay experience.
• Heroes boast three unique skills, with ultimate abilities requiring precise activation. Time your assaults adeptly to disrupt enemy actions and seize control of the fray.
• Adapt your tactics to diverse battle terrains, utilizing obstacles for cover in woodland skirmishes or launching swift assaults in open clearings.
• Employ flamethrowers, landmines, and other tactical implements to outmaneuver your foes. Deploy isolating walls to alter the tide of battle in your favor.
SUMMON AND TEAM UP SUPREME HEROES
• Tailor Your Formations for Triumph
• Join our open beta and uncover 46 heroes spanning all factions. Witness the valor of the Kazetsu, the vitality of the Werewolf, and the resilience of the Wukong. Let muster your legions, while the eternal struggle between Celestials rages on—all within the realms of Pixel Squad.
• Select from archetypal RPG classes to craft diverse lineups suited to any combat scenario.
ACCUMULATED RESOURCES
• Enhance Your Arsenal with a Simple Tap
• Bid farewell to resource grinding with our auto-battle and AFK functionalities. Continue accruing rewards even as you slumber.
• Elevate your team's prowess and seamlessly share equipment across all heroes. Engage with our intuitive crafting system, converting outdated gear into valuable resources without the hassle of grinding. Level up with ease and embrace the adventure that awaits in Pixel Squad!

bluejetty:00073542:ios.description:
A brand-new WeatherBug is here!
The weather app you rely on for live local radar, severe storm alerts, lightning alerts and pollen forecasts, now with a new design, an improved experience and even more ways to stay ahead of the weather.
Whether you’re planning your day, tracking a storm, checking your UV exposure, or wondering when the rain will start, WeatherBug gives you the weather information you need when you need it.
Explore new and improved features, including UV, Spark Lightning, Tropical Center, Precipitation Outlook and more, all designed to make understanding what’s happening outside easier and more useful.
Plan ahead with 10-Day Forecasts and over 140 hours of Hourly Forecasts, track changing conditions with interactive weather maps, and get timely severe weather alerts when conditions could impact your day.
WeatherBug brings your forecast, radar, lightning, severe weather, pollen, precipitation and more together in one easy-to-use app.
Because checking the weather shouldn’t just tell you what’s happening. It should help you know what to do next.
Join millions of people who use WeatherBug to stay informed, prepared and ready for whatever the weather brings.
WEATHERBUG FEATURES:
YOUR WEATHER FORECAST
• Real-Time Pinpoint Forecasts: Get the most accurate current, hourly, and 10-day weather forecasts
• Precipitation Outlook: See when rain or snow is likely to start and stop near you
• Enhanced Interactive Map: Visualize weather conditions with over 20 weather maps
• Lifestyle Forecasts: Know how the weather will impact your trips, workouts, allergies, chronic pain and much more
• Weather Widget: Customize your alerts and display them with weather widgets
• Severe Weather Alerts: Get alerted to thunderstorms, tornadoes, flooding and other severe weather near you
• Weather Videos: Get storm updates, weather explainers, seasonal outlooks, and practical safety tips from WeatherBug meteorologists to help you understand what’s happening and what it means for you.
TRACK ANY CONDITION
• Live Weather Radar: available across the U.S.
• Spark Lightning Alerts: track lightning near you with minute-by-minute, mile-by-mile lightning proximity alerts, ideal for outdoor sports, golf, pools and hiking
• Tropical Center: track hurricanes and tropical storms with forecasts and changing conditions
• Fire Center: global fire data to know when you are at risk
• Winter Weather: Stay safe in severe winter conditions with our real-time snowstorm alerts
MORE THAN JUST RAIN
• Pollen Count & Allergy Forecast: Keep your allergies in check by knowing what the local pollen conditions are like
• UV Index: Check local UV levels and know when sun exposure may be strongest
• Air Quality: Get an in-depth look at the air quality around you
• Precise Weather Details: Wind speed, weather observations and more
FASTEST WEATHER ALERTS
• Receive all National Weather Service watches, warnings, and advisories, including tornado and flood warnings.
CONNECT WITH US
• Facebook: @WeatherBug
• Instagram: @weatherbug
• TikTok: @officialweatherbug
• Check out WeatherBug's YouTube weather channel broadcast here: https://www.youtube.com/user/WeatherBugVideo
Download WeatherBug, the free weather app for live radar, severe storm alerts, lightning alerts and pollen forecasts, used and loved by millions. Awarded the "Best Weather App" in 2019 by Mediapost Appy Awards. Also, voted the "Best Weather App for iPads" by AppPicker and "Best App for Moms" by Parent Magazine: WeatherBug!

The future of professional & productive writing is here. Orki helps you write faster and better on your iPhone or iPad by integrating Artificial Intelligence API within an intuitive UI. 
Whether it's crafting the perfect email, composing creative stories, or just casual texting, Orki elevates your writing at every turn. 
It suggests better word choices, checks your grammar, translates, completes your sentences based on context, writes the perfect replies, and even helps you find the right words when you're stuck.
Write smarter instantly by trying Orki for FREE.
 GRAMMAR & SPELL CHECKER
Write correctly every time with the built-in AI grammar, punctuation, and spell check. Currently, we support 7 world languages with more to be added soon. Make typos and grammar mistakes a thing of the past.
 AI TRANSLATOR
Translate words live with the live AI translator and never let foreign languages be a communication barrier. Communicate in multiple languages seamlessly from one AI keyboard, without the hassle of copy-pasting or switching between translator and chatbot apps.
 PARAPHRASER
Change the tone of your text/email with a few taps and communicate adequately no matter who you are addressing. Whenever you are not satisfied with your writing, use AIType to express the same idea in different ways, ensuring your writing is fresh, unique, and engaging.
 OTHER WRITING HELP
Summarize long texts by getting help from AI. Check the grammar and spelling of your tweets before sharing. Or simply generate text based on your needs. Analyze and write eloquent replies with the help of AI. Whether it is a reply to a text or email, or writing help, Orki has your back.
Orki is a game-changer app for anyone who frequently uses their iPhone or iPad for writing. 
Try it now free and see how it can elevate your writing forever. 
The best part? You can use the AI keyboard in any app on your device.

bluejetty:00045026:ios.description:
Make the most of your HSA, HRA, and FSA health benefit accounts by quickly checking your balances and details. Our secure app makes managing your health benefits easy through real-time access and intuitive navigation to all your important account information on the go! Powerful features of the app include:
Easy, Convenient & Secure
• Simply login to the intuitive app using your same health benefits website username and password (or follow alternative instructions if provided) 
• No sensitive account information is ever stored on your mobile device
• Use Touch ID or Face ID to quickly log in to the mobile app
Connects You with the Details 
• Quickly check available balances 24/7 
• View charts summarizing account(s) 
• View claims requiring receipts
• Click to call or email Customer Service
• View your statements and notifications
• Scan product barcodes to determine their eligibility

• Take or upload a picture of a receipt and submit for a new or existing claim
• View, contribute and distribute HSA transactions
• Pay bills from any account and add a payee
• Manage your expenses by entering medical expense information and supporting documentation
• View and Manage your HSA investments
• Retrieve your forgotten username/password
• Report a debit card as lost or stolen
Powered by WEX®

LiteTV – Instant Entertainment, Zero Wait
Bored of hour-long videos? Drowning in endless scrolling?

Hit Stories You Can’t Miss
[30 Days Swapping Lives with a Mafia Boss]
A car crash turns two lives upside down.
A high-society heiress wakes up in the body of a feared mafia boss.
The gangster sent to kidnap her? Now trapped in her body.
They must fake each other's lives in a world of crime, stilettos, secrets—and sparks.
Mistrust, mistaken identity, and a love they never saw coming.
[Love You Beyond Six Months]
Janitor Sarah Milton and billionaire Daniel Rodney marry in a flash—but both want out.
Stuck in a six-month cooling-off period, they fake a life together while hiding their truths.
Then comes Matt, Sarah's first love… and the secret Daniel never saw coming.
Can a contract marriage turn into something real—or will their six months end in goodbye?

Welcome to Fit the Blocks, where relaxation meets brain-boosting challenges. Engage with an 8x8 grid filled with vibrant blocks. Features:
Relaxing Gameplay: Unwind with stress-free puzzles and simple controls.
Cognitive Boost: Enhance your mental skills with engaging puzzle activities.
Friendly Competition: Challenge your friends to outscore you in this thrilling game.
Unlockable Modes: Discover and unlock new game modes, each bringing a fresh twist to the gameplay.
Vivid Graphics: Enjoy the colorful, toy brick design that adds a fun and lively touch to your puzzle experience.

Whether you're taking a quick break or seeking a deep puzzle adventure, Fit the Blocks offers something for everyone. Download now and embark on your quest to become a Puzzle Master!

bluejetty:00063240:ios.description:
The cult-classic, family card game finally makes it to your mobile! 
DeckHeads is the perfect companion to any party or event bringing a traditional guessing-game up to date for the digital age. We’ve added a modern twist to the hit game, including current cultural references so get ready to act out ‘Falafel’, ‘Millennials’, and ‘Robert Mugabe’.
Accents, singing, miming, even frantic gesticulations are all required to help each player guess the word on the card. Guess as many as you can before the time runs out.
Choose from three main categories crammed with hundreds of cards to play with and unlock specialist subjects - Sport, Music, Entertainment, Christmas, Rude, and many more to keep the party going!
WARNING: Some words in the adult categories may cause extreme blushing!
Features:
Play in a pair or as a big group, one at a time or all at once.
Tilt your phone for the next card.
Tilt down after each correct word, up to pass.
Huge variety of cards including people, places, feelings, objects, etc.
Free Card Decks Include:
Family
Kids
Noughties
Additional Decks:
Around the World
Christmas
Film & TV
Music
Sport
And loads more!

bluejetty:00041766:ios.name: Cheerful Plants
bluejetty:00041766:ios.summary:
Your plants deserve better than scattered notes and a camera roll full of unlabeled photos.
Cheerful Plants is a personal journal for your plant collection — your photos, your care history, your reminders. Everything about your plants, in
bluejetty:00041766:ios.description:
Your plants deserve better than scattered notes and a camera roll full of unlabeled photos.
Cheerful Plants is a personal journal for your plant collection — your photos, your care history, your reminders. Everything about your plants, in one place, instead of in your head.
WHAT USERS ARE SAYING
"I have been using this app for 3 or 4 years. There are endless options so you can track as much or as little as you want! I track fertilizing, repotting, blooms, diseases, and the progress through photos! My favorite app!"
"I never have to worry about forgetting to water my plants."
"My poor ADHD brain has had a slightly difficult time keeping track of the minutiae for every plant. A few months ago, I dreamed up an app that would help. THIS is the app!"
"This isn't an ID or Diagnostic app! It's a Helper app: To help keep track of your succulents. I've tried a few other apps that try to 'do it all,' but they all fell short for me. I think this one is the best."
YOU DON'T NEED ANOTHER APP TELLING YOU WHAT TO DO
This isn't a plant ID tool or an AI care advisor. You already know your plants. You just need a better place to put everything you're tracking in your head.
Set your own watering reminders. Record care the way you actually do it. Look back when something goes wrong and figure out why.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO STAY ON TOP OF YOUR COLLECTION
- Custom Reminders — Set watering intervals for each plant. Color-coded badges show what's due, what's coming up, and what's fine. Snooze when you're busy. Disable for dormant plants.
- One-Tap Quick Water — Mark plants as watered in a single tap. Undo if you tapped too fast.
- Full Care Tracking — Log watering, fertilizing, pruning, repotting, pest treatments, and custom tasks. See your complete history for every plant.
- Photo Journal — Capture progress over time and build a visual record you'll actually want to look back at.
- Flexible Organization — Group by location, tags, or plant type. Create arrangements so you can care for plants together.
- Family Sharing — Share your collection with a sync key so family or roommates know exactly what to do when you're away.
- Memory Garden — A place for plants that are no longer with you. Keep their history instead of deleting it.
FREE FOR UP TO 5 PLANTS — ALL FEATURES INCLUDED
No locked features. No trial period. Start with 5 plants and see if it works for you. If your collection is bigger than that, upgrade to Premium for unlimited plants at $2.99/month or $29.99/year.
Made by Cassidy Tuttle of Succulents and Sunshine, helping plant lovers since 2013.
Terms of Use: https://cheerfulplants.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://cheerfulplants.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00069254:ios.name: AirDisk: File Transfer
bluejetty:00069254:ios.summary:
AirDisk is a wireless file transfer and file manager app that helps you move photos, videos, folders, documents, music, and archives between your phone, tablet, and computer.
Use local WiFi transfer to access your phone files from a comput
bluejetty:00069254:ios.description:
AirDisk is a wireless file transfer and file manager app that helps you move photos, videos, folders, documents, music, and archives between your phone, tablet, and computer.
Use local WiFi transfer to access your phone files from a computer browser. Open AirDisk, connect your computer to the same WiFi network, enter the browser address shown in the app, and start uploading or downloading files. No cable, no iTunes, no desktop software, and no cloud upload required for local WiFi transfer.
AirDisk is useful when you want to:
• Transfer photos from iPhone or iPad to Windows PC
• Move videos from phone to computer
• Send documents from computer to phone
• Transfer files over WiFi using a browser
• Access phone files without installing desktop software
• Organize folders, media, documents, and archives
• Manage files locally on your mobile device
• Use cloud storage when needed
Key features:
Wireless WiFi File Transfer
Transfer files between your phone and computer over the same local WiFi network. Use your computer browser to upload, download, and manage files.
Photo and Video Transfer
Move photos and videos from your phone to your computer without using a cable. This is helpful for backing up camera roll media, moving large videos, or freeing up phone storage.
Browser-Based Transfer
Access your files from a Mac, Windows PC, Chromebook, or other computer with a web browser. No desktop companion app is required for local WiFi transfer.
File Manager
Create folders, rename files, move files, copy files, delete files, organize folders, and manage your local storage from one place.
Document Viewer
Preview common document formats including PDF, Microsoft Office files, Apple iWork files, images, text files, and more.
Archive Tools
Zip, unzip, and manage archive files directly inside the app.
Music and Video Player
Play music and videos stored in AirDisk with built-in media player support.
Cloud Storage Support
Connect to iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, FTP, and WebDAV when you want to access or manage cloud files.
Privacy and Local Transfer
For local WiFi transfer, your files are transferred through your local network instead of requiring cloud upload. Your phone and computer must be connected to the same WiFi network, and AirDisk should stay open while transferring files.
AirDisk is designed for people who want a practical way to transfer files wirelessly, manage documents, move photos and videos, and access phone files from a computer browser.
Discover how AirDisk simplifies file management and boosts productivity.
• Learn more: https://airdisk.app
• Terms of Service: https://airdisk.app/terms-of-service
• Privacy Policy: https://airdisk.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00024316:ios.description:
Онлайн-общение уже давно не ограничивается обменом фразами и смайликами. Эмодзи, гифки и картинки помогают передать друзьям нужную эмоцию или просто поднимают настроение. Яндекс.Клавиатура объединила в себе всё необходимое для современной переписки. И ещё немного.
Что есть в Яндекс.Клавиатуре, чего не хватает обычной:
+ между русской и английской раскладкой можно переключаться свайпом,
+ есть готовые наборы гифок на разные темы и удобный поиск картинок в интернете,
+ пока вы набираете текст, в подсказках появляются подходящие эмодзи,
+ непрерывный ввод: чтобы ввести слово, проведите линию по его буквам, не отрывая пальца от экрана
+ встроенный переводчик помогает общаться, если собеседник не понимает по-русски,
+ если нужно что-нибудь быстро нарисовать, то можно что-нибудь быстро нарисовать!

bluejetty:00062853:ios.summary:
"Terribly addicting! ••••• I have refused for years to ever get into a single game app, and it was always easy until I found Word Jewels. So fun, so quick, I can't say enough about how much I enjoy the game!" --Jordan SC
Word Jewels is
bluejetty:00062853:ios.description:
"Terribly addicting! ••••• I have refused for years to ever get into a single game app, and it was always easy until I found Word Jewels. So fun, so quick, I can't say enough about how much I enjoy the game!" --Jordan SC
Word Jewels is SUPER FUN and 100% FREE!
••••• "This is such an addicting game. I absolutely love it!!!!!!"  --hb9202010
••••• "Love this game on my phone for all those 'waiting' times in life." --NannerBanner 
••••• "I absolutely love Word Jewels. I hope to keep playing this game for a long time. It is never boring. Thanks for making it free!" --2011bulldog
••••• "I like word games with friends, but get tired of the timed ones. It's really relaxing to take your time and strategize without racing the timer. And with a choice of five games I can play different ones and switch back and forth" --Jllew333
EASY TO LEARN AND PLAY!
• One-minute tutorial that teaches you how to play!
• Make words in any direction with just a swipe!
• Your goal is to make words that use up all the red jewels, but you only get a few "moves" each level to make words… You can do it!
SIX GAME MODES TO SUIT YOUR MOOD!
• Start with fan-favorite Word Jewels word-finding without the frustrations in Endless Mode!
• If you're daring, you can try Classic Mode where if you fail a level you have to start over!
• Want a super-hard challenge that's not for the faint of heart? Try Challenge Mode!
• Got ten minutes? Try Rally Mode to play ten levels of patterned jewels that are just like the multiplayer game Word Rally, but solo!
• Or try Blitz Mode! In just one level, how high can you score? Use the multiplier jewels and see how high you can get! Bet you can't just play it once…
• And NEW is Wordzing adventure mode, with lots of new challenging goals to pass each level. Collect certain color letter jewels! Connect a path of words across the board! Collect stamps under key letters on the board! Your word-finding adventure awaits!
RELAX WHILE YOU SHARPEN YOUR MIND!
• No timers, so take your time and find the best words
• Beautiful graphics and animation
• Relaxing sound effects
• Listen to your music while playing
GO FOR A HIGH SCORE!
• Score summary shows you how well you did
• Compare your scores with the world using Game Center
WORD LOVE!
• Huge English dictionary included to verify words even while not connected to the internet!
(Word Jewels uses the YAWL word list, which has 264,097 words! Valid words must be 3 letters long and NOT be proper nouns, as is typical for most every word game.)
• Automagic letter balancing, to help from getting trapped with a big ol' pile of consonants with no vowels, or with too many duplicates of the same letter in a group!
• Magic auto-save - go ahead and quit the game, take a phone call, send a text - when you come back, your game will be waiting for you! Works on both old and new iThings!
• 54 Game Center Achievements to earn!
Thanks for playing Word Jewels!
Come see us at http://boyhowdytechnology.com

Please check this out, also for the people who have not tried
bluejetty:00016891:ios.description:
‘Onion Cam2’ is a simple and useful app, which can take a time-lapse photography and create a movie by one-stop.
You can make interesting and great movies using your creativity!
Please check this out, also for the people who have not tried creating a time-lapse photography! 
'Onion Cam2' is the successor to 'Onion Cam'. The main difference is that 'Onion Cam2' now stores captured images in the app. Also, I was able to export it sideways.
Other than basic camera functions, the functions below are implemented.
・Onion-skin function
You can take a picture with checking the translucently displayed picture you took last time.
By this function, you can take gradually changing time-lapse photography easily.
You can adjust transparency and choose display and non-display mode by one tapping.
・Guideline display
You can set displaying guidelines.
You can choose display and non-display mode by one tapping.
・Changing order function
You can change the order of the pictures.
・Exporting movie function
You can export movies by this app.
You can set the time of switching pictures and the size of exporting file.
・Saving several projects
You can save several(32 projects for this version) projects.

iOS 17.6 or later

bluejetty:00041058:ios.summary: Get ready for adventure with 'ARK Unity'! Your all-in-one helper for ARK! Whether you're a rookie explorer or a seasoned survivor, this comprehensive guide app is your key to mastering the intricate realms of the updated ARK: Survival Ascen
bluejetty:00041058:ios.description:
Get ready for adventure with 'ARK Unity'! Your all-in-one helper for ARK! Whether you're a rookie explorer or a seasoned survivor, this comprehensive guide app is your key to mastering the intricate realms of the updated ARK: Survival Ascended (ASA) or ARK: Survival Evolved (ASE). No more tab-switching between sites, our all-in-one tool is your companion in this wild, untamed world.
FEATURES: 
TAMING CALCULATOR:
Don't just survive—thrive! Calculate the resources needed to tame any creature, with detailed stats on food, narcotics, and time required.
BREEDING CALCULATOR:
Propagate the strongest species with our breeding calculator. Know the gestation periods, mating cooldowns, and essential stats to help your newborn creatures inherit the best traits.
XP CALCULATOR:
Plan your pathway to dominance. Input your tasks to find out how much XP you'll gain, helping you level up efficiently.
CREATURE INFOS:
From the majestic Argentavis to the cunning Raptor, get detailed information on every creature you encounter or wish to tame, including stats, behaviors, and unique abilities.
SPAWN MAPS:

bluejetty:00038115:ios.description:
Get real-money rewards for every purchase you make with the Receipt Hog app! Whether you shop online or in-store, just upload receipts and start earning. It’s as easy as that!
So what are you waiting for? Turn everyday shopping into rewards and savings. Any purchase, any store, any time with Receipt Hog!
HOW TO GET THE MOST FROM RECEIPT HOG:
1. First thing's first - download Receipt Hog! 
2. Check out the new Welcome Bonus for easy ways to start earning.
3. Recently shopped in-store? Snap and submit a photo of any receipt from the last two weeks.
4. If you prefer shopping online, simply connect your email account for easy receipt uploads. Share only the receipts you want to. 
5. Track all your receipt uploads in one place for easy budgeting or returns. No more paper receipt wads in wallets and purses!
6. Link your Amazon or other loyalty accounts like Walmart, Target, and Costco to earn automatically!
7. Share feedback with your favorite brands and retailers through surveys and questionnaires catered to you.
8. Enter monthly sweepstakes for a chance to WIN BIG!
9. Redeem your earnings for real-money rewards from PayPal, Visa, or Amazon.
Receipt Hog takes your privacy very seriously. You’re in charge of what receipts you upload, what accounts you connect, and what surveys you take. Receipt Hog shoppers, like you, earn billions of coins every year - on your terms.
Download Receipt Hog and immediately start earning on your next grocery store run, restaurant visit, gas station or convenience store stop - even on your next online order!
With Receipt Hog, you earn rewards every time you shop - any store, any brand, online or in-person - no coupons, deals, or offers needed. Just share your paper or digital receipts and earn rewards! 
BONUS – Each receipt earns you slot spins and sweepstakes entries for huge prizes. Answer surveys about the places you shop and products you buy for even more rewards.
Using the Receipt Hog app earns you real money. Accumulate rewards and coins, then redeem coins for cash with PayPal, Visa, or Amazon.
It’s never been easier to use a shopper panel rewards app. No more clipping coupons, chasing down expiring deals, or missing out on savings. Simply shop, share your receipts, and automatically earn rewards for all your purchases. 
Turn all your receipts into Cash with Receipt Hog - any receipt, any store, any item. It's free, fast, and fun to use Receipt Hog!
PRO TIPS TO MAXIMIZE YOUR REWARDS:
1. Upload all paper receipts, no matter how big or small.
2. Connect your email account and check-in regularly to approve online receipt uploads.
3. Link all your loyalty accounts from your favorite shopping apps.
4. Upload weekly to max out your earning limit, level up, and earn frequency bonuses. The higher your level, the higher your rewards.
5. Earn slot spins with each receipt upload. Add to your bankroll by spinning daily, with a chance to win the Instant Win Spins jackpot.
6. Each receipt upload enters you into Receipt Hog’s monthly sweepstakes. The more you upload, the more entries you have for the Grand Prize.
7. Complete surveys and questionnaires.
Receipt Hog values your opinion and wants to make your experience the best it can be. Leave feedback in the ratings and reviews section and we’ll be sure to read and respond.
------
Receipt Hog is part of Numerator, a market research company. When you share receipts and take surveys, your data helps brands and retailers understand how people shop. In return, you earn real rewards. You're always in control of what receipts you upload, what accounts you connect, and what surveys you take.

bluejetty:00044776:ios.description:
What is CirrusMD?
With CirrusMD, you can chat with a doctor just like you would a friend. CirrusMD is chat-based virtual care that allows you and your dependents to securely message, send photos, or video chat with a doctor from your smartphone or computer.
It’s a convenient alternative to traditional doctor visits. No more waiting for an appointment, taking time off work, or paying the high cost of in-person doctor visits. With CirrusMD, you can connect with board-certified physicians who deliver comprehensive, whole-person virtual primary care that fits your schedule, budget and preferences.
How does CirrusMD work?
The CirrusMD experience is similar to texting. After registering, you can begin securely chatting with a licensed doctor, just like you'd text a friend. Start and stop your conversations as needed and use the platform as often as you'd like.
- Connect to a CirrusMD doctor, 24/7/365, from anywhere in the U.S.
- When it’s necessary, doctors can switch to video or ask you to share photos in the app
- Doctors can refill many prescriptions (controlled substances and certain other drugs may not be available)
- In-app translation for patients with Spanish as their primary language
- Complete in-app chat history for follow-up as needed
When should I use CirrusMD? 
Use CirrusMD when you feel sick but it’s not an emergency, for things like cough, fever, sore throat, earache, stomach pain, diarrhea, rashes, allergic reactions, sports injuries, burns, heat-related illness, even issues specifically related to men’s or women’s health. 
You can reach out to a CirrusMD physician when you:
- Have general medical questions 
- Are feeling anxious or depressed
- Have questions or concerns about a chronic condition
- Want information about health screenings, tests or test results
- Want to refill a prescription (controlled substances and certain other drugs may not be available)
- Aren’t sure where to go for care and need help
How can I get CirrusMD?
CirrusMD is a service provided as a benefit through your employer, health insurance, or another sponsoring organization. Visit mycirrusmd.com to learn more.

bluejetty:00098971:ios.description:
TORQ Sports is the ultimate FREE platform for student-athletes looking to take their game to the next level. Whether you’re aiming for college recruitment or want to showcase your athletic achievements, our app provides everything you need to stand out and succeed.
• Showcase Your Talent: Create a comprehensive athletic profile highlighting what makes you unique. Upload highlights and trim them before sharing. Connect with the sports community and build your brand.
• Connect with Colleges: Our College Connect feature puts you in direct contact with college programs across the country. Search and filter schools by division, location, sport, academic requirements, and more.
• Build Your Profile: Go beyond stats. Showcase your athletic achievements, positions, academic credentials (GPA, SAT/ACT scores), physical attributes, current school and graduation year, travel team and club affiliations. 
• Test Prep Included: Boost your academic game with built-in SAT and ACT practice materials. Access comprehensive prep questions for Math, Reading, Writing, and Science in English to ensure classroom success is as important as on-field performance.
• For the Entire Sports Community: TORQ Sports isn’t just for athletes. Coaches can scout talent, share training content, and build their program’s reputation. Parents can follow their athlete’s journey and connect with other sports families. Athletic directors and program directors can manage rosters and showcase their organizations.
• Social Features That Matter: Follow favorite athletes and teams, like and comment on highlight videos, share achievements with your network, get real-time notifications when coaches view your profile, and build your personal brand in the sports community.
• Roster Management: Teams and programs can create and manage digital rosters, making it easy to showcase entire squads to recruiters and organize team information in one place.
• Privacy & Security: Your data is protected with secure authentication and privacy controls. Choose what information to make public and control who can contact you. Verified badges help identify legitimate coaches and programs.
• Why Choose TORQ Sports:
 • Free to create your profile
 • Direct connection to college programs
 • Comprehensive athlete development tools
 • Active community of athletes, coaches, and fans
 • Regular updates with new features
 • Built by athletes, for athletes
Join thousands of student-athletes already using TORQ Sports to chase their dreams. Whether you’re starting your athletic journey or in the peak of your recruiting process, our platform gives you the tools to succeed both on and off the field. Download TORQ Sports today and start building your future in sports!

bluejetty:00015494:ios.name: MTestM
bluejetty:00015494:ios.developer: ShenZhen SamApp Technology Development Co., Ltd
bluejetty:00015494:ios.summary:
MTestM is an exam creator application that allows you to create, publish and share exams. Creating an exam has never been easier. You can add different types of questions on an Excel spreadsheet. 
MTestM is used by educators, trainers, non-
bluejetty:00015494:ios.description:
MTestM is an exam creator application that allows you to create, publish and share exams. Creating an exam has never been easier. You can add different types of questions on an Excel spreadsheet. 
MTestM is used by educators, trainers, non-profits, businesses and other professionals who need an easy way to quickly make exams, tests, and quizzes online. You can create and publish your first exam in a few minutes!
1.Create exams easily
Excel is a great program for creating questions. Exams can be created offline using Excel. By taking a tour, it’s easy to understand the MTestM format and add your own questions in the spreadsheet.
MTestM allows you to use Excel to write multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank and matching questions in a simple format that can be imported. When creating a large numbers of questions, MTestM can provide a quick way of bulk importing questions.
2.Advanced question types
MTestM allows you to create single choice, multiple choice, fill in the blank and matching questions. MTestM supports case sensitive answers and questions having more than one correct correct answer.
You can also create questions that are based on the same material or based on the same stem. You can also specify HTML, MathML, image, audio and video for the question.
3.Publish exams
After you have created an exam, you can publish it. You can mark your exams as private if you do not want others to see your exams, otherwise your exam can be seen by others.
In order to create high quality exams, we recommend you to update your exams regularly. MTestM allows you to update your published exams. If an exam is not the current version, it will be kept for 30 days on the server.
4.Share exams
Anyone can share public exams with others. Only you can share your own private exams with others. Others cannot share your private exams.
If you are a teacher, sharing exams is an alternative way to assign homework to your students. If you are a student, share your study quiz with your classmates and test each other as much as possible in order to discover even more details and areas you may have overlooked.
5.Organize exams into folders
Organizing exams is very important. You can organize exams into folders and subfolders.
Exams are saved locally on your phone, so you can search exams quickly using keywords. You can also find the exams and questions you recently took.
6.Take exams offline
MTestM allows you to take your exam anytime, anywhere at your convenience. You do not need to be connected to the internet while you are taking the exam.
After the exam is scored, you can review the grade report and see which questions you got wrong.
You can re-test yourself on the questions you’ve missed and you can re-test yourself on your favorite questions.

bluejetty:00074209:ios.description:
Capture the feeling with Birdy (formerly Pink Papaya), an ad-free photo and video journal for your private, personal thoughts. Save a memorable moment and caption without broadcasting it to the world. Journaling has numerous clinically-backed benefits, and it has been shown to improve both mental health and physical health. Join founder Sarah Nicole Landry of The Birds Papaya in creating your own daily habit to reflect, practice gratitude, and foster personal growth.
• Guided Prompts: Receive prompts, select photos and videos, and flow
• Choose Topics: Begin a journal for gratitude, reflections, goals, venting, or multiple topics
• Thought Starters: Jog your memory and help you start writing
• Daily Affirmations: Gently encourage you toward self-love and self-acceptance
• Scroll What Matters: A better-for-you alternative to social media, no ads or unhealthy comparison
• Complete Editing Suite: Add filters, overlays, customizable presets, text and more. No AI or body and face altering tools
The app has dozens of features FREE to use with no watermark! For even more features, sign up for Birdy+, which includes unlimited access to create multiple journals and unlock every editing feature.
____________________________
MEMBERSHIP PRICING, TERMS, & CONDITIONS
Birdy+ Yearly
The Birdy+ Yearly membership is 29.99 USD per year. Pricing in other countries may vary, and charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country you live in. The Birdy+ Yearly membership starts with a free 3-day trial period. Once the trial is over, you'll be charged $29.99 USD per year. Your Birdy+ Yearly membership will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your membership and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription during free trial.
Birdy+ Monthly
The Birdy+ Monthly membership is $4.99 USD per month. Pricing in other countries may vary, and charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country you live in. The Birdy+ Monthly membership automatically starts upon subscription and you'll be charged $4.99 USD per month. Your Birdy+ Monthly membership will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your membership and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.

Ookbee แอปปลิเคชันอ่านอีบุ๊ค
8 ความเท่มีสไตล์ เมื่อดาวน์โหลดแอป Oobee ไว้ในเครื่อง
1. CEO หล่อมาก ไม่เชื่อเสิร์ช หมูอุ๊คบี แล้วจะรู้ว่า “อุ๊คบี” เป็นแอปที่ดีต่อใจจริงๆ #CEOหล่อบอกต่อด้วย
2. โชว์สกิลกันหน่อย อีบุ๊ค ผวนเป็นคำว่าอะไร อีบุ๊ค = อุ๊คบี ไง ทีนี้จะเท่มากเวลาโชว์สกิลถามเพื่อนว่า อุ๊คบี ผวนมาจากอะไร ซึ่งผวนมาจากอีบุ๊ค ไงเล่า เพื่อนอึ้งไปเลย
3. ปฏิเสธไม่ได้จริงๆ ว่าการถือแท็ปเล็ทที่มีอีบุ๊คขึ้นมาอ่าน มันเท่ถึงเท่มากๆ ถ้าเป็นผู้หญิงก็ดูสวยฉลาดสุดๆ เหมือนหยิบสมาร์ทโฟนมาอ่านอีบุ๊คกับหยิบมือถือขึ้นมาเล่น Social ความหล่อความสวยมันต่างกัน ถืออุ๊คบีก็เท่เช่นนี้นี่เอง 
4. อุ๊คบี มีอีบุ๊คไทยให้เลือกอ่านเยอะที่สุดในประเทศ มีทุกประเภทหลากหลายให้เลือกอ่าน
5. มีหนังสือที่หาอ่านได้ตามแผงตามร้านหนังสือทั้งหมด แต่เป็นฉบับดิจิตอล มีทั้งอีบุ๊ค, อีแมกกาซีน, หนังสือพิมพ์ฉบับดิจิตอล, หนังสือเสียงและยังมีคลาสสอนออนไลน์อย่าง Skilllane ด้วย
6. มีทั้งซื้อขาดเป็นเล่ม สมัครสมาชิกรายปี หรือเหมาจ่ายรายเดือนรายปี อ่านฟรีทั้งแอพ Buffet กันไปเลย
7. อ่านฟรีได้ง่ายมากๆ แค่ Sign In ผ่าน Facebook ได้อ่าน Buffet ฟรีทันที 7 วัน โดยไม่มีค่าใช้จ่ายแอบแฝงใดๆ ทั้งสิ้น
8. Daily Prophet คือคำนิยามของ อีบุ๊คได้เลย ถ้าอยากอ่านหนังสือแล้วมีวีดีโอสัมสัมภาษณ์เบื้องหลังลับๆ ซ่อนไว้ในหลายๆ หน้า เพลินมาก หาจากนิตยสารเล่มกระดาษที่ไหนไม่ได้น้า
คุณสามารถส่งข้อแนะนำหรือแจ้งปัญหาต่างๆถึงเราได้ที่ member@ookbee.com หรือที่ fb.com/ookbee ขอบคุณที่ใช้ Ookbee ค่ะ!

There are both free and paid (with big discount from print edition) publications.

-Search/Browse/Download digital publications including:
---- 300+ digital magazines from the leading names such as MAXIM HELLO! Men's Health etc.
---- 1000+ e-books from renowned authors in the region.

-Read-on-the-fly, no need to wait for the publication to finish downloading.

bluejetty:00036656:ios.description:
"Brain Out" has brought a new era of puzzle-type hands and has gained a lot of popularity among players. "Brain Out 2" brings you more brand-new experience of mind-bending challenges, filled with unexpected puzzles that only the smartest players can conquer! This free offline puzzle game is designed for those who love pushing their brain's limits and testing their cognitive abilities. With a variety of creative puzzles and unconventional solutions. Get ready for a series of mind-twisting puzzles that will put your brain power to the test and push you to set new records!
This game is packed with innovation and subversive ideas. Unlike typical puzzle games, Brain Out 2 uses tricky and often humorous ways to test players. Each level feels like a unique brain teaser that challenges your reverse thinking and observation skills, putting you in seemingly impossible situations and compelling you to look at problems from different angles.
Key Features:
- Unexpected solutions with endless creativity
Brain Out 2 brings innovative ways to solve puzzles, challenging your thinking ability and making every puzzle feel fresh and intriguing!
- Train your logical thinking and boost your brain's IQ
Through thought-provoking puzzles, the game en-hances your problem-solving skills and helps you reach a higher level of cognitive prowess.
- Expand your thinking capacity with out-of-the-box ideas
Uncover unconventional solutions and tackle every challenge with creativity and innovation.
- Endlessly fun puzzles that are hard to put down
With unique gameplay that's both addictive and rewarding, every puzzle offers a mix of humor and challenge that's sure to captivate you.
- Cute doodle art style with engaging visuals
Every level is designed with charming, humorous visuals that are easy on the eyes and add to the game's light-hearted atmosphere.
- Interesting background music that complements the gameplay
Fun soundtracks make the game even more enjoyable, creating an immersive experience.
- Offline game – play anytime, anywhere
Enjoy this addictive puzzle game on the go without worrying about connectivity!
Whether you're an enthusiast who loves training your brain, improving memory, the moran test, and enhancing your IQ, or a creative thinker who likes breaking the mold with reverse thinking, Brain Out 2 is a must-play puzzle game for you! Come and unleash your imagination, think beyond the box, and become the master who can see through the puzzles' true nature. Only those with extraordinary logical skills, sharp memory, and boundless creativity will be able to conquer all levels and complete this ultimate brainpower challenge!

bluejetty:00033080:ios.summary:
Embark on a grand adventure in LEGO® Hill Climb Adventures, where iconic LEGO worlds and Hill Climb Racing collide!
The goal of LEGO Hill Climb Adventures is simple: explore, race, upgrade, and progress forward! Navigate through unlockable
bluejetty:00033080:ios.description:
Embark on a grand adventure in LEGO® Hill Climb Adventures, where iconic LEGO worlds and Hill Climb Racing collide!
The goal of LEGO Hill Climb Adventures is simple: explore, race, upgrade, and progress forward! Navigate through unlockable diverse locations, from the sunny countryside to the highest mountains and the daunting Great Below, in your quest for adventure. Overcome obstacles and complete quests by customizing and building a diverse set of vehicles, race against others in multiplayer rivals mode and unlock customization options to choose your own style! 
Along the way, you'll collect unique LEGO® Minifigures and gadgets, enhancing your exploration and building experience. LEGO Hill Climb Adventures is all about discovery and progression. Create your own path to success as you explore, build, and race!
Where will your adventure take you?
FEATURES: 
* NEW! Rivals Mode
Challenge players worldwide in Rivals Mode! Race head-to-head in multiplayer races, climb the leaderboards, and earn exclusive seasonal rewards!
* NEW! Customize Your Avatar 
Unlock customization options for your avatar and choose your style!
* NEW! Driver Perks
Unlock perk points and customize your character's unique powers to fit your playstyle.
* Discover Fun Adventures and Amazing Stories
Meet unique LEGO Hill Climb Adventures characters who will have exciting storylines with a variety of missions for you to undertake and complete. 
* Vehicles and Gadgets 
With a variety of vehicles, each equipped with unique active and passive gadgets, the possibilities are endless! Experiment with different combinations to tackle challenges or compete against players from around the world in multiplayer races!
* Upgrade and Improve 
Collect coins and bricks scattered throughout the levels to permanently boost the power of your vehicles!
* Hidden Paths and Secrets
Explore each level as they will have multiple paths for you to traverse, along with sneakily hidden secrets for you to discover! 
* Meet the LEGO Minifigures
LEGO Hill Climb Adventures brings a host of memorable characters from Climb Canyon allowing you to meet a variety of lovable, fun characters!
* Test your Skills
Figure out the best way to complete the missions given to you by the Minifigure residents of the world by selecting your vehicle and equipped gadgets carefully. Some combinations might work better for certain missions! 
If you have any issues please get in touch with our support team by emailing us at support@fingersoft.com We greatly appreciate your feedback and thank you for playing!

bluejetty:00022938:ios.name: U.S. Bank Instant Card™
bluejetty:00022938:ios.summary:
Instantly extend your corporate purchasing power to those who need it in your organization with U.S. Bank Instant Card™.
Instant Card combines the capabilities of a U.S. Bank virtual credit card with the power of an Apple device to create
bluejetty:00022938:ios.description:
Instantly extend your corporate purchasing power to those who need it in your organization with U.S. Bank Instant Card™.
Instant Card combines the capabilities of a U.S. Bank virtual credit card with the power of an Apple device to create a completely digital payment experience. 
With just a few simple steps, you can easily create and send an Instant Card to anyone in your organization who needs it for business expenses. It eliminates the need to pay for business expenses with a personal credit card and seek reimbursement.
FEATURES:
• Send cards to employees and contractors from a web portal or mobile app in real-time
• Set the card activation period to the exact time needed
• Set the card limit to desired amount (based on available credit limit)
• Push the virtual card to Apple Wallet with a single click
• View the full card number and CVV code securely
• Integrated with U.S. Bank Access® Online for reporting 
• Send multiple cards to a single user
• Deactivate cards immediately when no longer needed
HOW IT WORKS:
An authorized provisioner for your organization will receive an email invitation from U.S. Bank with all the information to download the app and register. Once registered, the provisioner creates a virtual card by:
1. Setting the credit limit and expiration date.
2. Entering basic recipient details.
3. Pushing the virtual credit card to the recipient through the Instant Card app.
The recipient will receive an email notification with instructions to download the app and register. Once the recipient registers, the virtual card is active and can be added directly to their Apple Wallet.
REQUIREMENTS: 
Organizations must be a U.S. Bank Instant Card customer and you must be either entitled by the organization as an authorized provisioner or sent a mobile card by a provisioner. To become an Instant Card customer, interested businesses can contact U.S. Bank at 800.344.5696.

bluejetty:00039685:ios.description:
Meteox is the new and improved international weather app created by Infoplaza. The app provides weather forecasts up to 14 days for over a million locations worldwide using the latest global weather data models available. Personalise your app by creating alerts for your favourite locations to make sure the weather doesn’t ruin your day. The app includes a 'live' rain alarm that works throughout Europe and a lightning alarm that works worldwide.
Why download the Meteox app?
- It's simple and easy to use
- Extensive weather forecasting for over a million locations worldwide
- Weather forecasts for the next 24 hours up to 14 days
- Rain alarm throughout Europe
- Worldwide lightning alarm with 98% accuracy
Meteox uses the best weather data available, which is then analysed by professional meteorologists. This data is also used by major companies and governmental institutions. Our customers rely daily on accurate and reliable weather services so the Meteox app has been created to help their daily activities become a little bit more predictable.
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Another example is you can jump to any date to check the child’s records for medical reference. 
Still, our services need a lot of field tests and improvements. We therefore pledge to listen to feedbacks, either from parents or staff, as carefully as possible and deliver more features to your hands.

1、3D 经络穴位：在 3D 模
bluejetty:00084537:ios.description:
知源经络穴位（原中济经络穴位APP），一款专为中医从业者、医学生及广大中医养生爱好者量身打造的 3D经络穴位与人体解剖学习平台。我们以业内顶尖的 3D 引擎技术为核心，将晦涩难懂的中医理论与人体经络穴位进行了 3D 可视化呈现。无论您是需要学习探索十二正经、奇经八脉、董氏奇穴的专业人士，还是希望通过推拿、艾灸、食疗来解决日常亚健康问题的养生达人，都能在这里获得直观、专业、高效的实操指导与健康辅助。
一、业内领先的独家 3D 模型与可视化动画
1、3D 经络穴位：在 3D 模型上完整呈现十二正经、奇经八脉、经外奇穴、经别、经筋、皮部与络脉，并收录董氏奇穴、小儿经络及头部、面部、足部、耳部、手部全息反射区。支持 360 度旋转、无极缩放，一键选中全部经络并高亮当前穴位，认穴找穴更直观。
2、高清 3D 解剖（辅助精准取穴）：提供成年男女、小儿等多场景模型，高精度还原骨骼、肌肉、心血管、神经、器官与淋巴系统。肌肉层次可增可减，经络与解剖透视叠加，帮您核对穴位的真实深度与周边组织关系。
3、穴位进针透视动画：自研 3D 进针模拟，呈现每个穴位的入针角度、安全深度与针尖经过的肌肉、神经、血管等组织，并标注风险区域与禁忌部位。
4、分步定位取穴动画：结合骨度分寸与体表标志，分步演示取穴流程，看图即懂。
5、经脉循行动态演示：还原《黄帝内经》所述经脉走向，展现经络联络脏腑、外络肢节的完整路径；开启内络透视后，器官遮挡处也清晰可见。
6、姿势切换与模型模板：站立、侧身、侧平举自由切换，选穴时自动换到最佳体位；常用的显示设置与视角可存为模板，下次一键还原。
7、国家标准经穴挂图：内置国家标准经穴部位挂图与小儿标准穴位图，可缩放、可点按查看穴位详情。
二、智能 AI 诊断与养生调理系统—您的贴身健康管家
1、AI 舌诊、面诊、手诊与体质检测：上传照片或回答问题，结合中医“望、闻、问、切”分析体质与健康状态。
2、中医问诊模拟测算：还原专业中医师的辨证逻辑。写下主述、上传舌象、勾选当下不适，系统便如医师坐诊般逐层问诊，辨病位、辨病因、辨病性，推演出证型与核心病机，并列出可供查阅的辨证依据。
3、定制专属调理方案：针对失眠、疲劳、肩颈酸痛、脱发、肠胃不适等亚健康问题，生成涵盖茶饮、食疗药膳、艾灸、推拿按摩、针灸、气功运动与作息情绪管理的综合方案，配图文与真人视频指导。
4、结果可追溯：检测与搜索结果均附数据来源说明，并提示仅供学习参考、不能替代医生面诊。
三、海量权威中医百科大全—装在口袋里的中医智库
1、经络穴位图解大辞典：覆盖十四正经、经外奇穴与董氏奇穴，解析五腧穴、原络穴等特定属性与主治配穴，配高清解剖图与真人实操视频，并呈现历代定位演变。
2、临床疾病百科：收录 700+ 常见内外妇儿病症，源自“十四五”权威教材，提供病因辨证、经典医案与针灸、拔罐、刮痧、推拿等外治方案。
3、中草药与药膳：数千种中草药的性味归经、功效主治与配伍禁忌；上千种药膳结合二十四节气与个人体质，指导日常食疗。
4、千本正版古籍：收录《黄帝内经》《伤寒杂病论》《金匮要略》《针灸甲乙经》等上千本人民卫生出版社正版典籍，支持在线阅读与进度续读，针灸歌赋配白话注释与语音朗读。
5、医家、术语与知识图谱：历代医家的学术思想、中医术语速查与中医基础理论；知识图谱以关系网络串联穴位、经络、病症、中药与典籍。
6、沉浸式阅读：支持全文朗读、阅读模式、深色模式与字号调节，古籍原文可对照白话解析。
四、沉浸式互动模拟中医小游戏
1、辨证入门演练：古风背景模拟真实临床场景，通过互动对话收集症状，引导您建立正确的辨证思路。
2、归经宝典闯关：以趣味闯关记忆穴位与经络，告别死记硬背。
3、舌象辨析模拟：对比不同舌色、舌苔的真实案例，快速掌握基础舌诊。
4、奇遇中医探索：以休闲解谜的方式探索中医基础，内容涵盖中草药识别、针灸推拿、阴阳五行，以及太极拳、八段锦、气功等传统养生功法的图文科普。
五、高阶实用辅助工具库
1、子午流注与经络时钟：结合纳甲法、纳子法、灵龟八法与飞腾八法，按当前时辰推荐当令经络与最佳穴位。
2、五运六气推衍：传统中医历法与运气学说计算工具，辅助时令病因分析。
3、真太阳时与桌面小组件：按当地真太阳时运行，经络循行、养生时钟与灵龟、飞腾八法开穴更精准；桌面小组件让时辰开穴一眼可见。
4、执业题库与学习：面向医学考研与执业中医师考试的题库，可按艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线生成学习计划，并支持错题本与专项复习；模型端可记忆上次学习视点。

listings.description:
知源经络穴位（原中济经络穴位APP），一款专为中医从业者、医学生及广大中医养生爱好者量身打造的 3D经络穴位与人体解剖学习平台。我们以业内顶尖的 3D 引擎技术为核心，将晦涩难懂的中医理论与人体经络穴位进行了 3D 可视化呈现。无论您是需要学习探索十二正经、奇经八脉、董氏奇穴的专业人士，还是希望通过推拿、艾灸、食疗来解决日常亚健康问题的养生达人，都能在这里获得直观、专业、高效的实操指导与健康辅助。

一、业内领先的独家 3D 模型与可视化动画
1、3D 经络穴位：在 3D 模型上完整呈现十二正经、奇经八脉、经外奇穴、经别、经筋、皮部与络脉，并收录董氏奇穴、小儿经络及头部、面部、足部、耳部、手部全息反射区。支持 360 度旋转、无极缩放，一键选中全部经络并高亮当前穴位，认穴找穴更直观。
2、高清 3D 解剖（辅助精准取穴）：提供成年男女、小儿等多场景模型，高精度还原骨骼、肌肉、心血管、神经、器官与淋巴系统。肌肉层次可增可减，经络与解剖透视叠加，帮您核对穴位的真实深度与周边组织关系。
3、穴位进针透视动画：自研 3D 进针模拟，呈现每个穴位的入针角度、安全深度与针尖经过的肌肉、神经、血管等组织，并标注风险区域与禁忌部位。
4、分步定位取穴动画：结合骨度分寸与体表标志，分步演示取穴流程，看图即懂。
5、经脉循行动态演示：还原《黄帝内经》所述经脉走向，展现经络联络脏腑、外络肢节的完整路径；开启内络透视后，器官遮挡处也清晰可见。
6、姿势切换与模型模板：站立、侧身、侧平举自由切换，选穴时自动换到最佳体位；常用的显示设置与视角可存为模板，下次一键还原。
7、国家标准经穴挂图：内置国家标准经穴部位挂图与小儿标准穴位图，可缩放、可点按查看穴位详情。

二、智能 AI 诊断与养生调理系统—您的贴身健康管家
1、AI 舌诊、面诊、手诊与体质检测：上传照片或回答问题，结合中医“望、闻、问、切”分析体质与健康状态。
2、中医问诊模拟测算：还原专业中医师的辨证逻辑。写下主述、上传舌象、勾选当下不适，系统便如医师坐诊般逐层问诊，辨病位、辨病因、辨病性，推演出证型与核心病机，并列出可供查阅的辨证依据。
3、定制专属调理方案：针对失眠、疲劳、肩颈酸痛、脱发、肠胃不适等亚健康问题，生成涵盖茶饮、食疗药膳、艾灸、推拿按摩、针灸、气功运动与作息情绪管理的综合方案，配图文与真人视频指导。
4、结果可追溯：检测与搜索结果均附数据来源说明，并提示仅供学习参考、不能替代医生面诊。

三、海量权威中医百科大全—装在口袋里的中医智库
1、经络穴位图解大辞典：覆盖十四正经、经外奇穴与董氏奇穴，解析五腧穴、原络穴等特定属性与主治配穴，配高清解剖图与真人实操视频，并呈现历代定位演变。
2、临床疾病百科：收录 700+ 常见内外妇儿病症，源自“十四五”权威教材，提供病因辨证、经典医案与针灸、拔罐、刮痧、推拿等外治方案。
3、中草药与药膳：数千种中草药的性味归经、功效主治与配伍禁忌；上千种药膳结合二十四节气与个人体质，指导日常食疗。
4、千本正版古籍：收录《黄帝内经》《伤寒杂病论》《金匮要略》《针灸甲乙经》等上千本人民卫生出版社正版典籍，支持在线阅读与进度续读，针灸歌赋配白话注释与语音朗读。
5、医家、术语与知识图谱：历代医家的学术思想、中医术语速查与中医基础理论；知识图谱以关系网络串联穴位、经络、病症、中药与典籍。
6、沉浸式阅读：支持全文朗读、阅读模式、深色模式与字号调节，古籍原文可对照白话解析。

四、沉浸式互动模拟中医小游戏
1、辨证入门演练：古风背景模拟真实临床场景，通过互动对话收集症状，引导您建立正确的辨证思路。
2、归经宝典闯关：以趣味闯关记忆穴位与经络，告别死记硬背。
3、舌象辨析模拟：对比不同舌色、舌苔的真实案例，快速掌握基础舌诊。
4、奇遇中医探索：以休闲解谜的方式探索中医基础，内容涵盖中草药识别、针灸推拿、阴阳五行，以及太极拳、八段锦、气功等传统养生功法的图文科普。

五、高阶实用辅助工具库
1、子午流注与经络时钟：结合纳甲法、纳子法、灵龟八法与飞腾八法，按当前时辰推荐当令经络与最佳穴位。
2、五运六气推衍：传统中医历法与运气学说计算工具，辅助时令病因分析。
3、真太阳时与桌面小组件：按当地真太阳时运行，经络循行、养生时钟与灵龟、飞腾八法开穴更精准；桌面小组件让时辰开穴一眼可见。
4、执业题库与学习：面向医学考研与执业中医师考试的题库，可按艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线生成学习计划，并支持错题本与专项复习；模型端可记忆上次学习视点。
5、一键分享：经络图谱、动画演示与百科内容可生成高清长图或网页链接，快速分享至微信、小红书、快手等平台。
知源经络穴位，让博大精深的中医智慧，成为您触手可及的健康生活指南。海量高阶功能持续上新中，立即下载，开启您的 3D 中医探索之旅！

bluejetty:00074151:ios.description:
Meet the CUSTOM, best meal plan app to combine healthy recipes, meal planning, grocery lists, and macro tracking! The Wholesome Yum app was created by Maya Krampf, founder of Wholesome Yum (the popular healthy recipe website) and author of 2 best-selling cookbooks. This recipe app will make healthy living so much easier and tastier, while saving you time and effort.
Here's what you get with this easy, healthy app...
** FREE VERSION **
* MACRO TRACKER - The app has a built-in macro calculator and automatically tracks tens of thousands of foods and recipes to meet your goals.
* CHOOSE YOUR LIFESTYLE - This healthy eating app is perfect for a balanced lifestyle, low carb, or keto. Choose what works best for you, and the recipes will match!
* DELICIOUS RECIPES - Get endless variety with tried-and-true recipes from Wholesome Yum! Find healthy recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, and everything in between! You can also browse by ingredient, prep method, dietary restriction (like dairy-free, keto, or nut-free), cuisine, holiday, season, and more.
* WATER TRACKER - Set a goal for water intake each day and track how much you drink.
* MEASUREMENT TRACKER - Log your weight, body measurements, blood glucose, and mood. Watch the app track your goals over time!
** PLUS VERSION **
With Plus, you get EVERYTHING from Free above, AND ALSO:
* RECIPE SCALING - Scale the serving size AND the recipe yield for all the recipes in the app, with nutrition info adjusted automatically. Scaled recipes can be used in the macro tracker as well.
* AD-FREE RECIPES - Browse all the delicious recipes in the Wholesome Yum app and website without ads.
* DEDICATED SUPPORT - Get dedicated help and community for your healthy lifestyle! Maya and other experts on her team will personally answer every question.
* DISCOUNTS ON HEALTHY INGREDIENTS - Get 15% off zero sugar sweeteners, flours, syrups, baking mixes, and more.
* MONTHLY GIVEAWAY - Get automatically entered for a chance to win ingredients, cookbooks, gift cards and more.
* SAVE FAVORITE RECIPES - Your favorites will also sync between the app and the Wholesome Yum website.
** PREMIUM VERSION (Most Popular!) **
With Premium, you get EVERYTHING from Free and Plus above, AND ALSO:
* CUSTOM MEAL PLANS - Start with a flexible meal plan tailored to your lifestyle, then customize it however you want: move healthy meals around, swap for different recipes, etc.
* AUTOMATIC GROCERY LIST - The biggest time saver! Your healthy shopping list will update as you customize your meal plan.
* CUSTOMIZE RECIPES - Add, remove, or replace ingredients to what you like or have on hand! The nutrition info, your macro tracker, and grocery list will auto update to match.
* LEFTOVERS - Save time and money by incorporating leftovers into your plan, with just a couple taps.
* MEAL PREP IDEAS - I'll give ideas for EVERY recipe, but you choose how much you prep ahead.
* FOR YOU OR YOUR FAMILY - Choose individual or family right away, and scale recipes to any number of people!
* SYNC ACROSS ALL DEVICES - Your meal plan syncs across all your phones and tablets, and your computer.
* SAVE PDF OR PRINT - Auto generate a PDF of your healthy meal plan or grocery list, which you can save or print.
Sticking to a healthy lifestyle doesn't have to be complicated. Whether you struggle with what to eat, how to calculate and stick to your macros, what recipes to make, how to plan your meals, or just love delicious food... the Wholesome Yum app takes care of it all -- in a custom way for YOU.
FOR PAID SUBSCRIPTIONS: Payments will be charged to Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the your Account Settings after purchase. By purchasing,you accept our Terms (https://www.wholesomeyum.com/about/terms-disclosures) & Privacy Policy (https://www.wholesomeyum.com/about/privacy-policy).
