bluejetty:00044132:ios.name: QuickDrop - Share from Android
bluejetty:00044132:ios.summary: With QuickDrop, you can seamlessly send and receive photos, videos, text files, and more between your Android phone and your iPhone, iPad or Mac using Quick Share on the same Wi-Fi network. Received files are stored in the Files app and tra
bluejetty:00044132:ios.description:
With QuickDrop, you can seamlessly send and receive photos, videos, text files, and more between your Android phone and your iPhone, iPad or Mac using Quick Share on the same Wi-Fi network. Received files are stored in the Files app and transmitted with end-to-end encryption over Wi-Fi, so no cloud is involved in the process.
To send files from your iPhone or iPad to your Mac or Android device, just select "Share" or tap the share icon for a file you want to transfer and choose "QuickDrop". If you don't see QuickDrop in the list, scroll right until you see "More", then choose "Edit" and enable the toggle for QuickDrop.
Other devices on the same network with QuickDrop installed and running will appear automatically. You can also open QuickDrop, tap a device and choose one or more files from the Files app, choose one or more photos and videos, or send the contents of your clipboard.
After that, you will see a notification on your other device, which allows you to accept or decline the file transfer. To receive files, you simply need to open the QuickDrop app.
You can also download the optional QuickDrop Android app for additional features. Transfer files without a shared Wi-Fi network and mark devices as trusted to automatically accept incoming transfers.
QuickDrop lets you send and receive files for free. Upgrade to QuickDrop+ for unrestricted transfer speeds and access to all current and future features. QuickDrop+ is available as a one-time purchase or a flexible subscription that you can cancel at any time.
QuickDrop is an improved version of NearDrop. Nearby Share and Quick Share are trademarks of Google, LLC and Samsung Electronics. Android is a trademark of Google, LLC. This application is not affiliated with Google, LLC or Samsung Electronics.

bluejetty:00041458:ios.name: Magical Maintenance Mystery
bluejetty:00041458:ios.summary: At first it seems like an ordinary apartment maintenance job. Meet the residents, help them with their problems, and definitely don't search their apartments while they're not home (but it's just so tempting, and no one will ever know, righ
bluejetty:00041458:ios.description:
At first it seems like an ordinary apartment maintenance job. Meet the residents, help them with their problems, and definitely don't search their apartments while they're not home (but it's just so tempting, and no one will ever know, right?). But you'll quickly realize something else is going on. Lights flicker, toilets attack you, and there are plenty of secret rooms and lost histories to discover. This apartment is much bigger on the inside than on the outside...
Magical Maintenance Mystery is a half cozy, half spooky incremental text adventure from the developer of Nano Empire, Evelyn's Farm, Pocket Reality, and more.
Features:
-Explore a big open world at your own pace.
-Customize your character with four skills: Combat, Empathy, Engineering, and Investigation.
-Get to know four residents: Helen the young genius, Simon the artist, Willa the minister, and Bruce the entrepreneur; plus more characters you'll discover later.
-Fight bed bugs and roaches, but these will soon be the least of your worries...
-Solve puzzles, with a hint system if you get stuck.
-Fully accessible with VoiceOver.
-Play the complete game for free with no ads. An in-app purchase is available to permanently double your progress and unlock optional content.

bluejetty:00018848:ios.description:
YUMMI: EVERY MEAL LEAVES A MEMORY.
Your food photos, sorted, saved and ready to relive.
That amazing tasting menu. The street food that made your trip. The anniversary dinner, the birthday cake, the Sunday brunch with friends. You took the photo because the moment mattered. Then it disappeared into thousands of shots in your camera roll.
Yummi brings those moments back. Turn the food photos you already have into a beautiful diary of every meal, from five-star nights to everyday favorites, sorted by place and date in seconds. Relive any meal in a tap: by day, by city, or on a map of everywhere you've eaten. And see where the people you trust are eating next.
YOUR FOOD PHOTOS, SORTED 
• Log meals from your food photos, new or old, as Foodprints 
• Each meal is filed on the day you ate it, at the place you ate it 
• Rate it, add a note, and remember what to order next time 
• Restaurant meals and home cooking alike
LOOK BACK ANYTIME 
• Find any meal by day, place or city 
• See your meals in a calendar, on a map, and by every city you've eaten in 
• Save places you want to try as Foodmarks
SEE WHERE YOUR FRIENDS EAT 
• Follow friends and foodies and see their real meals in your Feed 
• Real photos from real meals, not anonymous reviews 
• Find new places to try near you or wherever you travel
YOUR LOG, YOUR RULES 
• Yummi is a food journal first 
• Keep any Foodprint private, or share it with friends and followers 
• Make your whole account private anytime 
• Delete your account anytime from Settings
Start your food log today. Log Foodprints and relive those memories.

bluejetty:00023054:ios.name: Legends of Runeterra
bluejetty:00023054:ios.summary:
A LEAGUE OF LEGENDS™ ROGUELITE ADVENTURE
Runeterra calls! Choose your champion and pick your path to power: a single-player roguelite romp through the world of League of Legends and Arcane, or a ranked card battler where strategy reigns sup
bluejetty:00023054:ios.description:
A LEAGUE OF LEGENDS™ ROGUELITE ADVENTURE
Runeterra calls! Choose your champion and pick your path to power: a single-player roguelite romp through the world of League of Legends and Arcane, or a ranked card battler where strategy reigns supreme. Unlock and level up dozens of characters in a hand-crafted love letter to fans of hero collectors and card games alike. 
THE STORY SO FAR
From the back alleys of Zaun to celestial Mt. Targon, forces small and large threaten to forever shift the balance of power—if not unravel the world itself! Star-forging dragon Aurelion Sol plots his cataclysmic revenge, while Lissandra, an even greater menace, lurks in the frozen north.
Only champions of Runeterra can follow the path that has been set—alone or as one—with YOU at the helm.
CHOOSE YOUR CHAMPION
Play as Jinx, Warwick, Caitlyn, Vi, Ambessa, or any of a growing cast of 65+ champions. The many legends of League are yours to collect, evolve, and master as you traverse the map of Runeterra.
Each champion brings unique, awe-inspiring powers and loyal followers to the fray. Whether you freeze your opponents where they stand (Ashe), plant fungal surprises for sneaky victories (Teemo), build an elaborate combo engine for a spectacular finish (Heimerdinger), no two champions play the same.
ADAPT & EVOLVE 
Every run is a canvas for your creativity, offering new cards, powers, and relics to augment your strategy and topple menacing foes. But choose wisely! Challenges increase in difficulty over the course of a run, and from one World Adventure to the next.
Each champion can be upgraded with Star Powers—permanent augments you can unlock between runs. Completing a champion’s Constellation yields immense power—and all new strategies—for you to command.
TOPPLE MIGHTY FOES
Test your mettle against iconic villains in World Adventures and Weekly Nightmares that set the stage for your spectacular displays of strategy and skill.
Beating the odds against the likes of Lissandra and Aurelion Sol will take experimentation, ingenuity, and maybe a touch of luck. Of course, the tougher the opponent, the sweeter the victory—and the richer the rewards!
UNCOVER NEW LEGENDS
Delve into the deep lore and rich, ever-expanding universe treasured by players of League of Legends and fans of the Emmy-winning series Arcane. With exclusive characters, story-driven adventures, breathtaking card art, and a staggering cast of new and familiar faces, there’s no better way to experience the breadth and depth of Runeterra.

bluejetty:00096094:ios.description:
Playing Final Fantasy Tactics? Keep every job tree, treasure chest, and missable recruit at your fingertips. Available for PSX, War of the Lions, and The Ivalice Chronicles.
Whether it's your first time through Ivalice or your tenth, FFT Companion is the only reference you'll need open next to the game.
NEVER MISS ANYTHING
- User-submitted unit build guides
- Playthrough checklist that tracks missable characters, items, and events as you go
- Full errand list, so you know what's worth sending your units on
- Spoiler-conscious: see what's ahead only when you choose to
WIN THE FIGHT BEFORE IT STARTS
- Detailed 3D maps of every story battle, side quest, and location, including treasure spots and deployment tiles
- Monster stats, poach items, and where to find them
- Complete ability data: effects, damage and success formulas, range, and area of effect
- Status effect reference you can check mid-battle
BUILD THE PERFECT PARTY
- Character planner to map out a unit's job path before you commit JP
- Team builder for your five-slot squad
- Every job in a list or a full tree, with stats, requirements, and equippables
- Zodiac compatibility chart: find out which allies boost each other and which enemies will hurt more than they should
FIND ANY PIECE OF GEAR
- Complete equipment database with filters, sorting, and search
- See exactly how and where to obtain any item
ONE APP, EVERY VERSION
Switch between PSX, War of the Lions, and The Ivalice Chronicles data with a single toggle. Stats, names, and abilities update to match the version you're actually playing.
Make your next playthrough your best one.
FFT Companion is an unofficial fan-made reference app. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix.

bluejetty:00073743:ios.name: LeadNav GPS
bluejetty:00073743:ios.summary: LEADNAV GPS is the professional off-road GPS for iPhone and iPad. Plan the route at home, run it with turn-by-turn voice guidance where there are no roads, and put your whole team on one map. Built for teams that work and travel off the gri
bluejetty:00073743:ios.description:
LEADNAV GPS is the professional off-road GPS for iPhone and iPad. Plan the route at home, run it with turn-by-turn voice guidance where there are no roads, and put your whole team on one map. Built for teams that work and travel off the grid: search and rescue, security details, expeditions, hunting camps, work crews, race teams and their chase crews.
NAVIGATE WHERE THERE ARE NO ROADS
• Turn-by-turn voice guidance from routes you build or import. Waypoints speak by name as you approach them.
• Red warning rings and blue proximity rings that adjust to your speed, so the call comes when you need it.
• Any ring you cross alerts, on the route or off it. Serpentine points keep you on the line without a word.
• Works with no signal at all. Navigation never needs a connection.
• Record tracks, convert them to routes, reverse a route to come back the way you went.
• Drop markers for anything you want to find again. Recon, Aviation and Hunting marker sets are included for everyone.
• Compatible with Bluetooth headsets, helmet intercoms and speakers for eyes-free navigation.
TRIP PACKAGES
• One file per trip, event or property: routes, tracks and markers together, with categories and Recently Deleted.
• Built on the GPX standard. Import from and export to any GPS device or planning software.
• Share a whole Trip Package with your team by AirDrop, Messages or email.
• Route Editor with Undo, Join Multiple Routes, Convert Markers to Audio Waypoints, Export to GPS Unit for Garmin, Lowrance and other units.
YOUR WHOLE TEAM ON ONE MAP
• Group tracking is included with the app. One Team Code, a QR or an invite link builds the team. Teammates join in seconds and see each other live.
• Runs over any internet connection: cellular, Wi-Fi at camp, or vehicle-mounted satellite internet such as Starlink.
• Keeps sharing with the screen locked when you turn on background tracking.
• No account, no login, nothing to sign up for. Your team identity is a random code you can reset any time.
COMMS (PRO LICENSE)
• Hold to talk with your teams from the pad on the map or from a wireless button. Release to send.
• Every message is written out as text in the team thread, so a call you missed at speed is still there when you look down.
• Several teams at once, each with its own channel and switch. Faster updates, teammate speed, off-screen arrows and breadcrumb trails.
PRERUNNING TOOLS (PRO LICENSE)
• PreRunner Bar and Pocket PreRunner: one-tap waypoint drops at speed, with a wipe-safe screen lock.
• Wireless buttons: drop waypoints, record tracks, zoom and talk with your hands on the wheel. Part of our patent-pending prerunning system.
• Waypoint Mic: hands-free voice notes at speed through your helmet comms.
• Speed Highlighter: paint the route green, yellow and red as you run it.
• Package Rules: proximity rings and marker symbols by name, saved in the file for everyone you share it with.
• Off Route Alert: hear it the moment you leave the line, and which side the route is on.
• Edit at speed: tap any waypoint in run mode to edit or delete it.
OFFLINE MAPS
• Free online map sources include USGS Satellite, USGS Topo and OpenStreetMap.
• The Entry and Pro Licenses add offline map imagery for every map type, MBTiles import and overlays, and custom map URLs. Select areas and store them before you go. Maps are provided by outside services and are subject to change.
LICENSES
The app is a one-time purchase. Entry and Pro are auto-renewing licenses, managed in your Apple account. Details at leadnavgps.com/pricing.
NOTES
• This is a high-powered GPS and needs power for prolonged use in the field. Continued background GPS use can dramatically decrease battery life.
• Wi-Fi-only iPads have no internal GPS chip. Use a cellular model, or an external GPS receiver with the app.
• Group tracking and Comms need an internet connection. Navigation does not.

bluejetty:00042036:ios.name: Vendetta Online
bluejetty:00042036:ios.summary: Explore the galaxy and carve out your own destiny in a 3D MMORPG. This truly cross-platform game enables thousands of players to interact as the pilots of spaceships in a vast online universe. Players may build their characters in any direc
bluejetty:00042036:ios.description:
Explore the galaxy and carve out your own destiny in a 3D MMORPG. This truly cross-platform game enables thousands of players to interact as the pilots of spaceships in a vast online universe. Players may build their characters in any direction they desire, becoming rich captains of industry, military heroes, or outlaws. A fast-paced, realtime "twitch" style combat model gives intense action, coupled with the backdrop of RPG gameplay in a massive online galaxy. Three major player factions form a delicate balance of power, with several NPC sub-factions creating situations of economic struggle, political intrigue and conflict. The completely persistent universe and detailed storyline add to the depth of immersion, resulting in a unique online experience.
Support for multiple platforms across desktop and mobile, all of which play together in a single unified game world. Pilots may seamlessly switch from one platform to another.
The game supports Xbox, PS4 and MFi game controllers, and features cross-platform voice chat, as well as voice-recognition text chat for hands-free typing, text-to-speech for reading mission and other game updates, and many other features.
Although the game can be played quite casually, this is a "real" PC-grade MMORPG, and is not a watered-down "mobile" game experience. Our native iOS version has exactly the same capabilities as the PC versions, with a different interface.
The game is updated frequently, usually every week or two, with the developers and userbase actively discussing the future of the game on the Vendetta Online forums. Many frequent updates are server-side and will not result in a visible "iOS app" update.
Vendetta Online offers three distinct access tiers:
1) Free, where you pay no money at all, and may earn "Crystal" currency through your gameplay, and spend it on certain higher-end ships and equipment. There are no level caps, and you may use your account to play on any other platform (like the Mac). Some high-level content is not available to the Freemium tier, like assembly of player-constructed Capital Ships. It takes many months to build these endgame assets, and Freemium players may work towards those goals, but not complete them.
2) Lite, where you basically subscribe for $1/month, gain the ability to earn 50% more crystal per day, and may build and own the Goliath-class Capital Ship. This ship may also be made "Enduring", causing it to store a permanent record of the ship's usage and history in the game, and making it into a trade-able part of the world.
3) Premium, where you no longer require "Crystal" currency, or even see it, and you only play the game itself the way it was originally intended. Trident-class Capital Ships are available.
Lite and Premium levels are available via In App Purchase, as well as blocks of Crystal.
If you have any problems or concerns, please contact us via email, or (preferred) by creating a Support Ticket on the game website (more secure, and it proves the account in question is yours). We are a small indie developer, but we respond quickly. Leaving reviews is not a very effective way to reach us about problems.
If you are looking to try out your game iOS account on another platform, be sure to "Convert" your account with email verification. You can do this in the Options area, after logging into the game.
-- LEGAL --
Duration and price of each subscription is displayed inside Vendetta Online's storefront, updated at the time of purchase. 1, 3, 6, and 12 month subscription lengths are available for both Premium and Lite modes. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions and auto-renewal can be managed/turned off in your App Store Account Settings.
End User Licensing Agreement:
https://www.vendetta-online.com/h/eula.html

bluejetty:00084721:ios.description:
InkAI: Your Personal AI Tattoo Studio & Artist Gallery
Transform your ideas into professional-grade ink with InkAI. Whether you’re dreaming of your first tattoo or you're an artist looking for a powerful design tool, InkAI combines advanced AI technology with a massive curated gallery of real-world inspiration.
GENERATE & REFINE WITH AI INPAINTING
Don’t settle for a "random" result. InkAI gives you total control:
Text-to-Tattoo: Describe your vision and watch the AI create a custom masterpiece in seconds.
Precision Inpainting: Need to change just one detail? Use our AI Inpainting tool to select any part of your design and redraw it. Swap a rose for a skull or change a sleeve pattern without losing the rest of your design.
3,000+ REAL ARTIST DESIGNS
Explore an ever-growing library of over 3,000 tattoos from professional artists worldwide.
Discover Styles: From Fine Line and Minimalism to Traditional.
Social Inspiration: Like your favorites, follow specific artist styles, and sort by popularity to see what’s trending in the community.
Smart Filters: Easily find exactly what you need by filtering through styles and artists.
PRO-GRADE EXPORTS & UPSCALING
We bridge the gap between digital design and real skin:
HD Upscaling: Turn your concepts into high-resolution files with a single tap. No more blurry references for your tattoo artist.
Vector & Image Formats: Export in PNG or high-quality SVG (vector), perfect for printing stencils or further professional editing.
Stencil Ready: Create clean, crisp designs that are ready to be used by any tattoo shop.
KEY FEATURES AT A GLANCE:
• AI Tattoo Generator: Create unique art from text.
• Magic Inpainting: Modify and edit specific areas of your tattoo using AI.
• 3,000+ Artist Gallery: Browse, like, and sort real designs.
• High-Res Exports: Download in SVG and PNG.
• HD Enhancer: Upscale your designs for maximum clarity.
• Advanced Filtering: Sort by likes or filter by artist.
Why InkAI?
While other apps just give you a static image, InkAI offers a professional workflow. From the first spark of an idea to the final SVG stencil, we provide the tools to make your tattoo journey perfect.
Download InkAI today and design the art you’ll be proud to wear forever.
Terms of use: http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00021175:ios.description:
ปิ่นโต อีบุ๊ก by Fictionlog – ร้านหนังสือหิ้วได้ที่ให้นักอ่านได้ อ่านนิยาย และ อีบุ๊กออนไลน์ แบบจัดเต็ม ครบทั้ง นิยายวายนิยายรัก นิยายแฟนตาซี นิยายแปล นิยายจีน มังงะ การ์ตูน และหนังสือทั่วไป บรรยากาศอบอุ่นเหมือนได้เข้าร้านหนังสือจริงๆ ที่ทุกคนรัก
ฟีเจอร์ดีต่อใจสำหรับนักอ่าน
- ร้านหนังสือออนไลน์ที่รวม อีบุ๊ก จากสำนักพิมพ์ดัง นักเขียนปัง มีครบทุกแนว ไม่ว่าจะเป็น แฟนตาซี วาย โรแมนซ์ กำลังภายใน ย้อนยุค
- แบ่งหมวดหมู่ละเอียดสุดใจ ค้นหา นิยายแปลจีน หรือ การ์ตูนมังงะ ได้ง่ายขึ้น
- มีทีมงานแนะนำหนังสือใหม่ให้อ่านทุกสัปดาห์ ไม่ต้องเลือกเองก็เจอเล่มที่ใช่
- ตั้งค่าการอ่านได้ตามใจ ทั้งขนาดตัวอักษร ความสว่าง สีพื้นหลัง และการปัดหน้าแบบแนวนอนหรือแนวตั้ง
- รองรับการอ่านแบบ ออฟไลน์ ไม่ต้องมีเน็ตก็อ่านได้ทุกที่

bluejetty:00071663:ios.description:
Ready or not... the ultimate hide and seek mystery begins now!
A scary monster is on the loose - and it's hunting you. But in this scary survival game, staying hidden just isn’t enough! You’ll need to think fast as you transform yourself into anything in the room - a chair, a lamp, even a toilet! Be careful! Blend in, stay still, and fool the beast before it hunts you down. 
Or how about you flip the script and take the reins? It’s your time to become the hunter! Seek out tricky players hiding in plain sight. Sharpen your senses and keep your eyes wide open- can you find them all before time runs out?
Whether you’re running from the beast and its fury or taking the hunt into your own hands, this hide and seek prop hunt adventure is loaded with suspense, scares and thrilling surprises. Every round is a new battle. Every room is a creepy playground. Are you clever enough to outlast the creature's attack?
With heart-pounding survival gameplay and a fun twist on the classic game we all know and love, it’s time to dive into the creepiest seek and find challenge ever!
Your next spooky adventure awaits.
Hunt & Seek Features:
- Transform into well known objects and hide anywhere!
- Hunt hidden players before they get away!
- Fast-paced, fun seek and find gameplay
- A true test of quick thinking, stealth, and strategy!
- Escape terrifying monsters and creepy creatures.

bluejetty:00066090:ios.summary:

This is a classic point-and-click game inspired by the 90s classics that defined the
bluejetty:00066090:ios.description:
A POINT-AND-CLICK ESCAPE ROOM
- Remastered version with better graphics and hint system!
- Try for free before deciding if you want to purchase it or not!
This is a classic point-and-click game inspired by the 90s classics that defined the genre for so long. Think of it as my attempt to honor those old games that meant so much to me as I grew up.
In this game, you’ll explore a newly discovered temple that has been forgotten for thousands of years. It contains many rooms packed with puzzles and riddles, waiting for you to uncover its secrets.
Your old friend has been living in the temple for the past few months, investigating and trying to solve its mysteries. Then suddenly, no one hears from him anymore. The only person brave enough to enter the temple and search for him is, of course, you.
Will you find him? The temple is working against you, with each room filled to the brim with puzzles and riddles trying to stop you from uncovering all its secrets.
Some puzzles are like mini-games that you can solve right away; others require you to pause and observe your surroundings for clues. Some are easy, while others are much more difficult. The game features a built-in hint system that will nudge you in the right direction or completely reveal the solution if you choose. There’s no need to get stuck, as the next room awaits with new puzzles to solve and items to discover!
The rooms in Legacy 3 are filled with items and clues that are there to help you on your quest. Interact with amazing touch controls to inspect your newly found keys and tools. If you see something that looks interesting you can use your camera and take a photo - of whatever you like! Trying to remember that instruction you saw ten rooms before? No problem - just use the camera and you don't have to!
This game is in 3D, with smooth controls and a camera that allows you to take photos of anything in the game. No need to memorize difficult hints or notes!
So what are you waiting for? The adventure awaits! Can you solve all the puzzles and find your friend?
Features:
• Hint system to help when you’re stuck on a puzzle
• Auto-save feature that tracks your progress throughout the game
• So many puzzles to solve
• Even more hidden objects to discover
• Available in English, French, German, Portuguese, Spanish, and Swedish
• Over 25 rooms to explore!
I really hope you enjoy this game. If you do, there’s another one waiting for you: Legacy 4: Tomb of Secrets.
Follow development of next game here: 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nosignalproductionss/

【Tip 1】如何使用单手模式在大屏iPhone上进行输入？
百度输入法允许用户根据手型和握姿任意调节键盘的大小、高度甚至位置，让您单手也能轻松输入！在输入面板的工具条上点击键盘调节icon进入编辑页面，自定义您的个性键盘，更可快捷切换。
【Tip 2】 如何启用百度输入法？
第一步：安装后，进入系统设置—>通用—>键盘—>添加键盘—>第三方键盘 选择 百度-百度输入法 —> 百度-百度输入法 —> 开启完全访问（同步开启云输入、百度输入法设置同步）—>完成
第二步：打开任何输入框—>长按地球键 选择 中文-百度输入法 （默认拼音9键）
【Tip 3】 如何开启滑行输入、键盘手写等高级功能？
第一步：进入系统设置—>通用—>键盘—> 中文-百度输入法 —> 开启完全访问
第二步：打开任何输入框—>点击输入面板左上角熊头—>在下拉菜单中使用高级功能
【Tip 4】 如何用百度账号备份用户词库和设置项？
第一步：进入系统设置—>通用—>键盘—> 中文-百度输入法 —> 开启完全访问
第二步：点击桌面APP图标—>点击“输入设置”—>点击“云备份”并登录百度账号—>点击“备份设置项/用户词”。
＝＝＝自动订阅服务说明＝＝＝
1. 订阅服务：输入法特权包（连续包月）、输入法特权包（连续包年）
2. 订阅价格：
a) 输入法特权包（连续包月）产品为首月优惠1元/月，非首月为8元/月
b) 输入法特权包（连续包年）产品为优惠价10元/年，原价为88元/年
3. 付款：用户确认购买并付款后计入iTunes账户
4. 自动续费：苹果iTunes账户会在到期前24小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺延一个订阅周期
5. 关闭服务：您可以在苹果手机“设置”-->进入“iTunes Store与App Store”-->点击“Apple ID”，选择“查看Apple ID”，进入“账户设置”页面，点击“订阅”，管理自动订阅服务，如需取消，每个计费周期结束前24小时关闭即可，到期前24小时内则不再扣费
6.服务协议：
a) 百度输入法会员服务协议：https://srf.baidu.com/site/automember/index.html
b) 百度输入法自动续费协议：https://srf.baidu.com/site/autofee/index.html

The StudentVUE Mobile application helps students stay informed and connected by providing day-to-day insight into their own academic experience. StudentVUE Mobile works with the Synergy™ student information system in much the same way as the StudentVUE web portal, allowing students to stay on top of upcoming school events, classroom happenings, assignments, tests, and academic performance. Students can view their classroom assignments and scores, attendance and more. 
How to find District URL and Login Information:
The StudentVUE Mobile for the iPhone/iPod Touch app uses the same user login as the web-based StudentVUE portal.  If you need help please contact your School District’s Administration office for access URL and StudentVUE login information.
Requirements:
• Only school districts using the Synergy™ student information system version 6.5 and higher can support the StudentVUE for the iPhone application. 
• Requires wireless or 3G Internet connection.

bluejetty:00029865:ios.summary:
PLAI – Create AI Characters & Interactive Stories
PLAI lets you design your own AI characters and bring them into conversations, adventures and group scenes. Build a character in minutes by describing who they are and how they speak, then
bluejetty:00029865:ios.description:
PLAI – Create AI Characters & Interactive Stories
PLAI lets you design your own AI characters and bring them into conversations, adventures and group scenes. Build a character in minutes by describing who they are and how they speak, then chat, write stories together, or drop them into an interactive adventure where your choices shape what happens next.
Create your own characters - Give a character a name, a personality, a backstory and a way of speaking. Choose an avatar, pick a voice, and set the scenario. Every character is yours to edit at any time.
AI Adventures - Play through branching stories where you are the main character. Each reply you send changes the direction of the narrative, so no two playthroughs are the same. Start from a community adventure or write your own.
Group scenes - Put several characters in one conversation and watch them interact with you and each other.
Memory that lasts - Characters remember earlier conversations and details you have shared, so a story can continue across days and weeks rather than starting over each time.
Voice replies - Hear characters speak their lines with a selection of natural-sounding voices.
Creative tools Generate character portraits and scene images directly inside the app to illustrate your stories.
Private by design - No account or sign-up is required. Your chats are tied to your device, and you can export or permanently delete everything from Settings at any time. Moving to a new phone takes one code.
Content controls - A content filter is built in and can be set to a family-friendly mode. Any character, story or community post can be reported or blocked.
Over 30 languages - PLAI is fully localized and characters reply in the language you write in.
Free to use Everything above is available for free. PLAI Pro removes ads, raises daily limits and unlocks longer memory. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period and can be managed in your Apple ID settings.
EULA - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 
Privacy Policy - https://pl-ai.app/privacy
Terms - https://pl-ai.app/terms

apple-itunes:6826737980.name: MeBoard: Glide & Haptics
apple-itunes:6826737980.description:
MeBoard is the keyboard you set up your way: glide typing, tunable haptics, any layout you like and a split keyboard for big screens.
GLIDE TYPING
Slide through a word's letters without lifting your finger. MeBoard picks the word using the word before it, adds the space for you and shows other guesses above the keys. Words you use often glide too.
HAPTICS YOU CAN TUNE
Set the strength and feel of every keypress, with a separate feel for letters and for keys like delete and shift. Choose what vibrates: keys, long-presses, even each step as you slide the cursor. Key sounds are optional.
SPLIT KEYBOARD FOR FOLDABLES AND IPAD
On large screens like the iPhone Duo unfolded or an iPad, MeBoard splits into two thumb halves with one wide space bar. Set portrait and landscape separately and choose the gap.
LAYOUTS YOUR WAY
QWERTY, QWERTZ, AZERTY, Dvorak, Colemak, Colemak-DH and Workman, or build your own: add and remove keys, change what they type and their labels, resize them and set long-press characters. Add a number row, adjust height, spacing, corner radius and label size, or switch to one-handed mode.
FAMILIAR IF YOU PREFER
Keep the comma and period beside the space bar, or hide them for a classic iPhone bottom row. Choose symbol pages laid out like Gboard or like the iPhone keyboard.
A TOOLBAR YOU ARRANGE
Show only the buttons you want (hide keyboard, layouts, number row, one-handed, cursor arrows) and put them in any order.
SMART TYPING
• Autocorrect that understands neighboring keys, so "thw" becomes "the", and fixes missing spaces and apostrophes
• Context-aware fixes like "I'm jot" → "I'm not"
• Backspace undoes a correction; tap your original word to keep it
• Next-word predictions that learn your phrases
• Emoji suggestions as you type, like a pizza for "pizza"
• Your own text shortcuts, like "omw" → "On my way!"
• Long-press any key for symbols and accents
• Slide on the space bar to move the cursor; swipe left from delete to erase whole words
• Number pad in number fields, @ in email fields, .com in web addresses
• Light, dark or automatic theme
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
MeBoard has no network code, no analytics and no ads. What you type, the words it learns and your settings never leave your device.
Full Access is only needed for haptics, to load the settings you choose in the app and to remember the words you teach it. MeBoard works without it.

firefox-addons:3003482.name: Hawk Translate
firefox-addons:3003482.summary: More than just a translator: improve your vocabulary, reading, and listening skills in any language using natural-voice pronunciation and word family discovery. With a clean UI and multiple free backends.
firefox-addons:3003482.description:
Hawk Translate is a fast, distraction-free translation and language-learning companion. Select any text on any website to get an instant translation, natural-voice pronunciation, and — for single words — grammar and synonyms to grow your vocabulary. Watch YouTube, Netflix, and Prime Video with two subtitle languages at once, and train your ear with dictation on real lines from the video. Save the words you want to keep and learn them with built-in flash cards.
What you can do
Watch YouTube, Netflix, and Prime Video with bilingual subtitles. A new button in the player shows two subtitle lines at once — the video's language on top, yours below. On YouTube, both lines come from YouTube's own captions (including YouTube's auto-translations) and stay in sync line for line. On Netflix and Prime Video, pair two of the title's own subtitle languages (perfect timing, nothing leaves the page), machine-translate the original track into your language with the provider of your choice, or load your own subtitle file (.srt, .vtt, .ttml) for titles that only ship one language. Machine-translated lines appear progressively and are cached per title, so re-watching never re-translates. On ad-supported Prime streams, subtitles stay in sync across ad breaks. Lines can be resized on the spot, and your language pair is remembered and applies automatically on the next video. Pause and select any subtitle word to translate or ☆-save it — subtitles become study material. If YouTube's auto-translation is unavailable, your translation provider fills in the second line instead.
Practice dictation. On YouTube and Prime Video, turn on bilingual subtitles and choose Dictation practice in the subtitle menu. Hawk hides the subtitles, plays one line from the video, and pauses so you can type what you heard. Every word is marked correct, wrong, missing, or extra, and you get a score plus the line's translation. Replay the line as often as you like, or replay it slower. Pick your level: Beginner uses short lines (6 words or fewer) with half the words already filled in, so you type only the blanks; Intermediate uses lines of up to 12 words; Advanced uses every line. Ask for a hint, skip a line, or show the answer. The practice panel can be dragged anywhere on the video, its text size is adjustable, and you can assign a keyboard shortcut to start and stop it.
Select and translate. Highlight text; a compact bubble shows the translation right next to your selection.
Listen. Click the speaker 🔊 to hear the original or the translation in a natural voice. Click the same text twice for a slower replay — great for pronunciation practice.
Learn vocabulary. Select a single word and Hawk shows its part of speech (noun / verb / adjective …) and synonyms, so you see the whole word family at a glance.
Save words and review them as flash cards. Tap the ☆ on any translation to add it to your study list. Review your words on a spaced-repetition schedule: words you know come back less and less often, words you miss come right back, and words you've mastered graduate out of the rotation. Export your list to Anki, CSV, or JSON anytime.
Keep a local history. Every translation is saved on your device — searchable, filterable by site and date, and exportable. You decide how long it's kept, or turn it off entirely.
Full-text popup. Click the toolbar icon to type or paste anything, pick your target language, and translate.
Right-click menu. Translate any selection from the context menu — no long mouse trips.
Keyboard shortcut. Assign a hotkey to translate the current selection instantly, even on pages where you've turned the bubble off.
Translate PDFs. Opt in to open web PDFs in the bundled viewer, so select-to-translate works on PDF pages just like regular web pages.
Multiple translation backends — no key required
Hawk Translate works out of the box with no setup. Pick your preferred service in the options:
Google — free, default, fast, high quality
MyMemory — free, no key, ~5,000 words per day
DeepL — your own key (free or paid plan)
Microsoft Azure Translator — your own free key (2M characters/month)
LibreTranslate — open source; point it at your own endpoint
If the chosen backend fails, a built-in "Try with …" chooser retries instantly with another provider — no detour through the settings.
Built for language learners
Bilingual subtitles on YouTube, Netflix, and Prime Video turn any captioned video into listening practice: hear the original, read both languages, and save the words you don't know without leaving the player.
Dictation turns watching into active listening: you hear real speakers at natural speed, type what you caught, and see exactly which words you missed. Beginner mode keeps it short and gives you half the words, so you can start without getting frustrated.
A speaker on both the original and the translation lets you hear the source language while you read the meaning.
The word-families panel shows nuance: seeing synonyms grouped by part of speech builds vocabulary faster than a bare translation.
Flash-card review turns the words you actually encountered while browsing into long-term vocabulary — no separate app, no account.
A compact, focused interface that stays out of your way.
Your settings
Theme: Auto / Light / Dark for the popup and the bubble.
Bubble style: Classic (compact) or Card (original and translation, each with its own speaker).
Auto-close: the bubble dismisses itself after a few seconds — hover to pause. Configurable from 0 (off) to 120 seconds.
When the bubble appears: a small hawk icon to click, instantly on selection, or only via popup / right-click.
Per-site control: disable the bubble on sites where you don't want it, straight from the right-click menu.
Supported languages
50+ translation languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Arabic, Hindi, Vietnamese, Thai, Turkish, Indonesian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, and more. Extension metadata localized in 20 languages.
Privacy
Hawk Translate does not collect or transmit any personal data to the developer. The text you translate is sent only to the provider you choose (Google, MyMemory, DeepL, Azure, or LibreTranslate). Bilingual subtitles read the captions YouTube, Netflix, or Prime Video already serves for the video you're watching; when both lines come from the video's own subtitle tracks, no translation provider is involved and that data never leaves your browser. Dictation practice runs entirely in your browser: it replays the video you're already watching and checks your typing on your device, and your answers are never sent anywhere or saved. If you choose the machine-translate option on Netflix or Prime Video, the subtitle text is sent to the translation provider you picked — just like any other translation — and the result is cached only on your device. On YouTube, if YouTube refuses its auto-translation, the second line is translated by the provider you picked instead: that video's subtitle text is sent to that provider, and the result is cached only on your device. Your translation history, saved words, and flash-card progress are stored only on your device — never uploaded, never synced, and removed if you uninstall. API keys you enter for DeepL, Azure, or LibreTranslate are stored locally in your browser and never sent anywhere except that provider's own servers for requests you trigger.
Open source
MIT licensed.
Hawk Translate is an independent project and is not affiliated with Google, Microsoft, DeepL, or MyMemory.

fdroid:com.osscabinet.ossWallet.name: OssWallet
fdroid:com.osscabinet.ossWallet.description:
OssWallet is a privacy-first, encrypted, and highly customizable personal finance manager.
All data is stored locally in a SQLCipher-encrypted (256-bit AES) database — nothing leaves your device except the network requests listed below.
Features:
* End-to-end local encryption of all financial data
* Multi-profile support to isolate separate sets of accounts and transactions
* Planned payments with automated recurrence scheduling
* Full-text search across transactions
* Customizable dashboard with a card-based layout
* Open in Web: an embedded local server to manage your data from a desktop browser on the same network
* Budgets, loans, and account structures for cash, bank, and credit accounts
* Currency conversion using live exchange rates (requires internet access; optional)
Network use (the only times the app goes online):
* Exchange rates: only when you tap refresh in Settings > Currency, or if you turn on "Update Rates Automatically" (off by default). Rates come from the provider you picked (open.er-api.com or api.frankfurter.dev); only the currency code is sent. Nothing is contacted during setup.
* Location picker: when you open the map or search for a place on a transaction, map tiles load from tile.openstreetmap.org and addresses are looked up through nominatim.openstreetmap.org.
AI assistant access (Android 16+) is off by default. If you turn it on in Settings > Security & Privacy, system assistants can read and add transactions, and the assistant may process that data off your device.
OssWallet does not require a Google account, does not use any proprietary Google Play Services APIs in this build, and does not include ads or trackers.
